games.name: Dr. Fetus' Mean Meat Machine
games.description: Help Dr. Fetus create the perfect Meat Boy clone in a unique new twist on the tile-matching puzzle genre. In classic Meat Boy fashion, an endless cavalcade of devious and deadly traps stand between you and victory in this hardcore puzzle game that will push your skills to the limit.
games.about: Dr. Fetus` Mean Meat Machine provides the perfect combination of classic puzzle-gameplay and hardcore platforming elements that Super Meat Boy is known for. Puzzle your way through beautiful hand-crafted worlds and more than 100 puzzle-levels, filled with creative traps and hazards. At the end of each world, prepare for a gruesome boss fight that will provide the ultimate challenge. Puzzle your way through familiar Super Meat Boy and Super Meat Boy Forever locations like the picturesque forest, the hospital, and salt factory in a fresh Puyo Puyo-inspired format. However, in Dr. Fetus’ Mean Meat Machine, matching at least 4 clones of the same kind and creating awesome combos isn't enough – you'll also have to avoid lethal hazards and traps, such as sawblades, rockets and pendulums. It’s a demented and hardcore spin on the classic puzzle formula you know and love! Dr. Fetus’ Mean Meat Machine takes place right after the events of Super Meat Boy Forever. After meticulously analyzing Meat Boy all throughout Super Meat Boy Forever (did you notice the cameras in the levels???), the nefarious Dr. Fetus now has all the data he needs to create the perfect Meat Boy clone! There’s just one problem: The DNA sample he’s collected isn’t a perfect specimen, which in turn yields some…less than perfect clones… But fear not, Dr. Fetus knows how to solve this problem. He creates a bunch of ruthless test chambers and starts sending all of the clones he’s created through them, in order to weed out the crap clones from the good ones. The specimens start out looking nothing like Meat Boy, but over time that grotesquely lovable face that Dr. Fetus hates so much, starts to emerge. Perfect clones are just on the horizon and after they’re done…who knows what happens next? Probably something to do joyously with torturing and killing lots of Meat Boys for the hell of it! Enjoy dazzling backgrounds and animations from the original Super Meat Boy & Super Meat Boy Forever artists and listen to the wonderful soundtrack by RIDICULON, with unique remixed Super Meat Boy Forever tracks and new tunes. Over 100 hand-crafted levels filled with unique and deadly traps Outrageous boss fights that up the ante with additional mechanics One-of-a-kind combination of puzzle and action gameplay Help Dr. Fetus create the perfect Super Meat Boy clone Revisit worlds from Super Meat Boy and Super Meat Boy Forever Original Soundtrack created by RIDICULON, with unique Remixes from Super Meat Boy Forever tracks and new scores Developed in cooperation with Team Meat and the original Super Meat Boy artists Test your skills to the limit with 30 Achievements to unlock

The truth is that she’s actually a succubus and was embarrassed not having any sexual experience at her age. He was suddenly pushed into the school’s special dormitory. It was a girls’ dormitory full of useless demons: Yuu, the yuki-onna who was extremely sensitive to the cold; Arle, the mummy girl who is uncomfortable with tightness and loves the feeling of freedom; Emiri, the hopeless angel who has no sense of modesty and who is also his step sister; and, Miyabi, the witch who passionately develops a love drug to bring happiness to the world. The dormitory was built to rehabilitate them and since he was mistakenly moved there, he was assigned as an assistant to watch over them. games.name: Backseat
games.description: A psychological taxi horror game where every passenger may be dangerous. Drive through the night, question criminals, read their behavior, hack for clues, and survive each ride to save your kidnapped wife.
games.about: Your wife has been kidnapped. To get her back, you must obey BK26: pick up dangerous strangers at night, learn what they know, and avoid giving them a reason to kill you. Drive the wrong people through the night Killers, thieves, fraudsters and unstable strangers sit behind you. Listen closely, watch their behavior, and uncover what they are hiding before the ride turns deadly. Question without provoking them Use your logbook to profile each passenger. Ask carefully, choose your words, and gather clues without pushing a dangerous person too far. Hack for the answer that keeps you alive Use your computer to search databases, dig through the deep web, and find critical information—maybe even how to defuse the bomb under your car. Survive each ride Complete BK26's missions: Deliver passengers, send your notes, and follow the trail toward your wife. Wrong move, fatal ride: Inside the taxi or outside it, one mistake can end the night. Decide your fate Obey BK26, look for another way out, and decide how much you are willing to risk. You are not driving for money. You are driving for your family.

games.name: The Last Case of Benedict Fox Definitive Edition
games.description: Take on the last case of Benedict Fox and dive into a twisted world of secret organizations, forbidden rituals, and cold-blooded murders. Explore the memories of deceased victims as you search for clues and fight demons in this fantastical Lovecraftian Metroidvania.
games.about: Experience The Last Case of Benedict Fox: Definitive Edition, featuring reimagined combat and traversal that is both intense and exhilarating. Paired with new lightning-fast animations and a substantially upgraded AI, topped by terrifying secrets and new stories to discover filled with brand-new puzzles, brace yourself for a thrill that will send shivers down your spine! Descend into a limbo of decaying memories as Benedict Fox, a self-proclaimed detective bound to his demon companion. Use that unholy bond to explore the minds of the recently deceased in search of clues as you uncover the mysteries of a massive, decrepit mansion — the site to a young couple's grisly murder, and the disappearance of their child. Immerse yourself in a dark, intriguing world full of secret organizations, forbidden rituals, and cold-blooded crimes in an arcane adventure brought to life through a fascinating Burton-esque art style. Fight demons, explore the subconscious, and solve elaborate puzzles in a labyrinthian adventure inspired by Lovecraft's nightmares, noir pulp fiction, and early 20th-century jazz music. Use your bond with the demon to explore the minds of the recently deceased in your last chance to get a “testimony”. Jump into surreal worlds where memories, emotions, and traumas take on a physical form. Uncover the secrets of an old mansion where a couple has been found slain, and their child has gone missing. Get drawn into a dark, yet intimate intrigue that will have you face the family’s demons - both figuratively and literally! Use your weapons, demon powers, and surroundings in creative combinations to overcome demons, monsters, and cultists - but remember that concentration and a tactical approach are your greatest assets.

games.name: VR Giants
games.description: VR Giants is a local/online co-op VR game in which one VR player and one screen player work together. The VR player controls a giant and must protect and support the tiny player who is controlled by the screen player. The tiny player can use the body of the giant as an extension of the level.
games.about: The Game: A VR player and a screen player play together on one PC in the same virtual world. The VR player becomes a giant and the screen player controls a tiny person. Only by working together they can solve the puzzles and regain their freedom. VR Giants sparks joy and teaches kindness and team communication in a fun and intuitive way by making use of the unique technological feature of two completely different input devices. Before you play: The game is designed to be accessible to players of all skill levels, allowing for fun experiences with friends, family, or significant others. You will require a 2m*2m play area. Please make sure your play area is set up properly before starting VR Giants. WARNING: VR Giants requires the VR player to move very actively (getting on their knees, moving up and down and so on). Please only play on your own responsibility and take breaks if you should feel any fatigue.Locomotion: In VR Giants locomotion works significantly different than in other VR games: It is not the giant player that can choose their own position inside the virtual world, but it is the tiny player that changes the giant’s position by stepping on buttons to activate new play areas. Enjoy intricate puzzles on your adventures through deserts, icebergs, lava caves and pastures to rescue David's lost sheep. Learn how to use Goliath different states to your advantage such as: Solid Goliath: The giant is summoned by a button that is pressed once and can be released afterwards. Temporary Goliath: Goliath appears at a play area only as long as David continuously presses the button. Fire Goliath: The giant is made from lava and must not touch David or any wooden objects. Play your adventures without dying and get great rewards like cosmetics.

games.name: LIFE EFFECT Survival
games.description: Survive in a harsh and dangerous world after an alien invasion. Gather resources, craft equipment, fight mutants and massive monsters, use weapons, vehicles and robots, explore territories, defend strongholds and fight for survival.
games.about: History: Alien invaders invaded the planet, exterminating most of the population, humanity, being on the verge of annihilation, united its armies and gave a serious rebuff to the enemy, bringing down all its might on him. After several years of war, the climate on the planet has changed significantly, the virus and alien particles have greatly mutated animals and humans. The military created fortifications for protection, and extraterrestrial technologies were mined, which helped create medicines and weapons, vehicles and robots. The war continues, some fortifications are fighting with each other, advancing their goals and ideas, trying to get alien artifacts with which they can move to the next stage of evolution and gain complete superiority. The player's task is to survive in this world by helping peaceful fortifications. Collect resources and create the best weapons and equipment, fight off enemy forces and prevent the invasion of monsters from other planets. In the game you will find: ✦ Survival in a harsh world from the first or third person perspective of a character. ✦ The lives of the surviving civilians and the activities of enemy groups. ✦ The infection of the world, mutations, many powerful creatures and Titans. ✦ Battles with alien life forms and their technology. The world does not stand still: ✦ The longer you play, the more events, encounters, quests, and unexpected situations unfold around you. ✦ Lots of quests, plot and stories, NPC stories and adventures, interactive events in the world. Three genres are one brutal reality. Shooter, RPG, and Horror elements. ✦ Shooter — intense shootouts where every decision can cost a life. Shoot tactically. Upgrade your hero to match your fighting style. And never forget that you are being watched. ✦ RPG mechanics — develop your character, enhance equipment, equipment, drones, turrets and robots. Influence the plot and choose your path. ✦ The atmosphere of survival and horror — the world presses, the enemies frighten, and the cold becomes a personal enemy. ✦ There is a place for real tension here. You don't just shoot — you survive, evolve, and be afraid. Every shot, every dialogue, and every rustle behind your back may be your last. Not just survival, technology is under control. ✦ Creative freedom — create weapons, armor, equipment, and even companions. ✦ Own your own army — build robots and cyborgs that will fight on your side. Your allies don't have to be human. ✦ Technology warfare — from drones to heavy armored vehicles: everything you build works for you. The use of technology, the creation of robots and unmanned aerial vehicles. Do you want a drone that scouts the territory? Or a cyborg who watches your back? Everything is in your hands. In the game, you don't just survive — you create. DNA, eggs, cubs, animals, people: ✦ Grow, tame, hire — assemble a squad to suit your style of play. ✦ Find, grow, create — find eggs, steal a baby, or extract the DNA of a monster and create a unique companion. ✦ Genetic Laboratory — use DNA samples to create new species and hybrids. ✦ Taming animals — find and tame wild or peaceful animals, they will become faithful helpers on the journey. ✦ Mercenaries — hire people who will fight on your side if you trust them with your back. ✦ Pets that grow up with you — your companions level up, learn new abilities and help in battle. Capture → development → defense. Your fortress is underground. ✦ Capture the bunker — recapture the underground shelter from the monsters and make it your base. ✦ Development and Improvement — Build crafting machines, a laboratory, an incubator, and other modules for storing resources, companions, and transportation. ✦ Defense — build turrets, fortify entrances, strengthen walls and personally repel hordes of enemies. ✦ Automatic resource collection — send mercenaries and pets in search of loot. There is an old bunker somewhere in the forest. It's crawling with monsters right now. Purify it and it will be yours. Develop the shelter: Strengthen the defenses to repel the attacks of the creatures. And when you are not there, send mercenaries and pets to collect resources. The bunker lives on, even when you're in combat. You are not alone in the world of LIFE EFFECT Survival. ⚠️ IMPORTANT ⚠️ 1. ⏳ If you have a black screen when starting the game, just wait a few minutes, the game will load 100% into RAM. I'm working on speeding up the launch of a client. 2. 🎮 There is currently no gamepad support in the game. 3. ⚙️ There is no key rebinding. 4. 📝 The game does not have cloud saves. It creates a save folder on your PC. 📢 Therefore, if these features are very important to you, please take this into consideration and do not purchase the game! At the moment, I cannot provide a timeline for when these features will be implemented.

games.name: The Forest of Drizzling Rain
games.description: From the creator of Angels of Death: the multi-ending exploration horror game The Forest of Drizzling Rain. Includes Full Ver. (2022), completed nine years after the original release, and Original Ver. (2013), where it all began. Alas, it was the "promised place," where Shiori was never meant to go.
games.about: ■WHAT'S INCLUDED This product contains two versions of The Forest of Drizzling Rain. - Full Ver. (2022) — The completed form of The Forest of Drizzling Rain, realized nine years after the 2013 original. - Original Ver. (2013) — Where it all began. You can choose which version to play from the launcher at startup. There is no additional cost. If this is your first time in The Forest of Drizzling Rain, we recommend starting with Full Ver. (2022). *Original Ver. (2013) runs on Windows only. Full Ver. (2022) supports both Windows and Mac. ■ABOUT THIS GAME — Full Ver. (2022) First released on "Freem!" on October 11, 2013, the multi-ending exploration horror game The Forest of Drizzling Rain was then rebuilt from the ground up—from story to visuals—and completed nine years later as Full Ver. (2022). Playing as Shiori Kanzaki, you will get to enjoy her visit to Azakawa Village, right up until you are plunged into a world of fear. 1) More endings to choose from, including bad endings with story lines at every turn, even from the very beginning of the game. There are additional late game ending routes and even a special scenario for players who conquer all of the endings. 2) A second chapter has been added between the first and second halves of Original Ver. (2013), during which you can freely walk around the map of beautiful Azakawa Village. Chat with some of the more colorful villagers, or spend your time fishing in one of the minigames while enjoying this new scenario. Who knows, maybe Shiori's accomplishments during the day will have an effect on her nighttime conversations with Suga. 3) Meet new characters with new story lines. There are many completely new additions to the story that never appeared in the manga or novels! 4) Enjoy the same polished finish and delicate attention to detail found in later titles such as Angels of Death, with newly rewritten conversations and events, and a map rebuilt from scratch. 5) the Taking Spirit is a shocking new scenario which paints a deeper picture of the sad truth that has haunted Azakawa Village for the past several hundred years. With all this and more, here is The Forest of Drizzling Rain in its completed form. Even veterans of Original Ver. (2013) are likely to find themselves repeatedly diving in to enjoy the refreshing new gameplay. One unassuming female college student, one tiny village, and one long night filled with incomprehensible fear. Why don't you try exploring Azakawa Village, and perhaps you can expose the hidden truth while you're at it. ■About Original Ver. (2013) The Forest of Drizzling Rain was first released as a freeware game on October 11, 2013. It retains the dark, raw touch of that era, when freeware horror was emerging title after title from the underground scene. In 2024, distribution of this version ended on "Freem!" and the Game Magazine app, due to changes in the distribution environment and the difficulty of continued support. Since then, there had been no official way to obtain it. In 2026, in keeping with the wishes of creator Makoto Sanada, it was revived—not as a standalone re-release, but as part of this product. Its addition brings no change to the price. If you already own this game, no additional purchase is required. To those who first met this story in Full Ver. (2022): we hope you will experience where it all began. *Original Ver. (2013) largely preserves the content of the original release, with some materials adjusted or replaced. *Supported languages: Japanese, English, and Simplified Chinese. ■STORY All alone following the death of her parents, Shiori Kanzaki happens to run across an old photograph in their bedroom. In that photograph, which bears the unfamiliar inscription "Azakawa Village," is a young Shiori with her parents, along with another man old enough to be her grandfather. Shiori goes looking for that village and pays a visit to the local museum, where she meets Kotaro Suga. Suga, the museum curator, strongly urges her to leave the village immediately. When Shiori continues exploring Azakawa Village, a secret truth gradually comes to light. What will her reaction be once all is fully revealed? ■PROFILE Makoto Sanada Makoto Sanada is a Japanese video game designer. His debut title, The Forest of Drizzling Rain, drew lots of attention when it was first made available on the Internet in October of 2013. And it continued to grow in popularity as translations appeared from volunteers in countries all around the world. His next game, Angels of Death, released in installments by Game Magazine (formerly NicoNico Game Magazine) starting in August of 2015 and continuing until the following February, saw an anime adaptation and went on to become a big hit. Together, both titles have garnered a wide fan base of all ages with their various multimedia releases including novelizations and comic adaptations. Crossing the boundaries between entertainment and literature with their sensitive character portrayals and bold plot lines, Makoto's stories have become hugely popular among fans both young and old. ■The Forest of Drizzling Rain Streaming Guidelines Game Magazine shall support secondary creation activities, such as the creation and distribution of manga, illustrations, original products, novels, and live videos, regarding the products made by vaka, Inc (hereinafter "the Company"). Through the secondary creation activities by fans, we wish to disseminate the attractiveness of individual products to many people. Therefore, we do not require individuals who perform secondary creation activities regarding the products made by the Company, which are general fan activities, not for profit (creation and distribution of self-published magazines, the posting of works on video or illustration sites) to obtain advanced confirmation from the Company or to inform it thereof. In addition, we do not require individuals who register secondary created products for the creator encouragement program (Niconico), or use on paid channels and YouTube channels obtaining advertisement profits to obtain advanced confirmation or to inform it thereof. Individuals or companies considering secondary creation activities for profit, which are not applicable to the above, shall inform us thereof via the Game Magazine Inquiry Form in advance. We sometimes receive requests from people to regulate specific individuals' secondary creation activities. Please understand in advance that we use such opinions as reference; however, we are unable to promise a response or reply to individual requests.

games.name: Gore Screaming Show
games.description: A deeply unsettling visual novel following a boy who returns to his hometown expecting to find peace; however, it isn't long before his hopes are dashed by the monster known as Gore Screaming Show.
games.about: Gore Screaming Show is a horror visual novel by esteemed developer Black Cyc, the minds behind the infamous SaDistic BlooD. In this, one of their most famous works, a boy named Kyoji seeks to unravel the mysteries that have taken root in his hometown while he was away. Mysteries tied to a young girl named Yuka, and her companion, the horrific Gore Screaming Show. The game plays out in a visual novel style format, with fully-voiced characters and beautiful 2D artwork by Ueda Metawo. Story With his parents moving to America for work, Jinno Kyoji returns to his hometown, Kurehito City, after several years of absence to live with his mother's cousin, the free-spirited Saitama Yamiko. There, he encounters several girls he shares a history with. Kazuyagi Akane, the strong-spirited tomboy he grew up with. Namiki Aoi, a gloomy girl who's Akane's best friend. Misono Kiika, a graceful, good-natured classmate of his from his old school. In three years of absence, his hometown and its people have changed ever so slightly. Despite some hiccups, Kyoji's peaceful days in his hometown begin. At least until he meets a mysterious girl on his way to his first day at school. Violet hair. Large, striking eyes. Skin that's paler than the driven snow. "Welcome home," she says. "My name is Yuka. Remember it." And wherever Yuka is, one mysterious, inexplicable figure is always nearby—a monstrous man by the name of Gore Screaming Show. Kyoji's encounter with these two figures marks the end of his peaceful days—as they bring chaos, violence, madness and despair into this world. Will Kyoji and the girl he loves be able to escape the madness and return to their peaceful days? Or will they— Features Hours of story content Japanese voice acting A classic horror experience Art by the legendary Ueda Metawo

games.description: A hyper-fast shopkeeping game where every task is performed with your aim! Keep performing at your best by thinking carefully about efficiency and task order. Three difficulty levels, from mouse beginners to seasoned experts! Online co-op and versus multiplayer supported.
games.about: "Aiming Skill" × "Panic" AMPANIC (AIM × PANIC) A shopkeeping game that puts your aiming skills to the test. No time to rest. Ever. Gather materials, process them, craft items, and serve customers―― A hyper-fast shopkeeping game where every task is performed with your aim! Let a customer get away... and it’s game over. Orders keep piling up, and customers keep flooding in. Keep your shop running with efficient task prioritization, quick decisions, and precise flick aiming. Every task is controlled with your aim! First, grab passersby and bring them into your shop. ------------------ Once a customer places an order, it’s time to gather materials. Fling your mouse around to collect materials from the field at lightning speed! --------------------- Check the recipe, then get to processing. Select the materials you need quickly and process them precisely. ------------------ Finally, crafting. Combine materials with tracking aim to complete the customer’s order. And of course, deliver it as soon as it’s ready. Extreme pressure: Let them leave, and it’s over! Even when your shop starts filling up with orders, taking your hand off the mouse is not an option. Customers get angry as time passes and eventually leave. As mentioned earlier, if a customer leaves, it’s game over. The moment you lose your cool, your shop falls apart. -------------- Chaos that changes with every stage The further you progress, the more complicated the orders become. Required materials, processing steps, and priorities. Everything speeds up, putting your decision-making skills to the test. The shop is overflowing with customers, and everything’s about to fall apart! ...That’s when you should use your skills. Spend the mana you’ve collected to deal with customers. Choose the skills that suit your playstyle and save your shop from disaster. Some customers come with special orders or bring trouble of their own. Your goal is to reach the sales target set for each stage. Can you keep this chaotic tool shop running? -------------- Online Co-op Multiplayer! Work together... or get in each other’s way. Online Versus Mode! Whenever you process a customer, a new customer is sent to your opponent’s screen. Keep going until your rival’s shop falls apart! -------------- A Roguelike Game Mode, Too! The final stage and versus mode use a roguelike format. Experiment with a variety of builds. The high-difficulty mode supports leaderboards, letting you check scores and builds from players around the world. Three Difficulty Levels to Choose From From mouse beginners to seasoned experts Features High-speed tool shop management controlled entirely with AIM Flick aiming and tracking aim are the keys to success Heart-pounding moments when you can't afford to lose a customer A frantic loop of gathering materials → processing → crafting → delivery Orders and difficulty change with every stage An extreme multitasking experience that’s all the more satisfying when things get chaotic - Gameplay Videos and Streaming - Gameplay videos and livestreams are welcome. Note: Please include the game title, “AMPANIC,” in your video or stream title. See you! -AMPANIC-

games.description: Roguelike Squad-based Autobattler in a Tabletop RPG setting. Draft your army, carefully equip and position your units, make important choices, and meet a colorful cast of characters as you make ready for the Grand Tournament.
games.about: Tales & Tactics blends roguelike strategy with squad-based autobattling. Experience a deep one-of-a-kind strategy experience tailor-made for a single player adventure. There are no time limits and no pressure - you have all the time in the world to take in the game's mechanics and characters, and to strategize correctly for the fight ahead of you. Guide your character’s story on their path to glorious victory in The Grand Tournament, the annual ultimate test of skill. Progress through a single-player adventure across 3 acts, battling rival characters and fierce bosses along the way. Build a squad of units from a wide variety of fighters - from Fae, Dragons and Treefolk to Skeletons, Ghouls, and Orcs! Collect a team of Tanks, Healers, Mages, Engineers and more - using their synergies to turn the tide of battle in your favor. Find powerful Equipment to give to your units, expand your Army Size, unlock new and more powerful tiers of Units, and acquire unique Level-Up Perks to help you on your journey. No two runs will have the same rewards on offer - and it’s up to you to make the most potent team possible. Unlock new features with each run - win or lose. Gain new Perks, Units, Items, and more, with an Unlock system that prioritizes expanding depth instead of granting more power. Each of these unlocks can be disabled, so you can ramp up the new systems and mechanics at your own pace. Once you’ve proven yourself in the Grand Tournament, try scaling the Challenge Climb, which adds both challenging difficulty increases and exciting new mechanics to the trials ahead. Or, try your hand at Asynchronous PVP - battle players from around the world in a true display of tactics and strategy! Features: Full single player roguelike Auto-Battler adventure Ranked and unranked PVP Over 200 items Over 200 perks Over 100 Units Unique Trait synergies 15 Difficulty Tiers to climb Custom Difficulty “At Your Pace” unlock system

games.name: Frostrain 2
games.description: Become the last conductor and rule over the final train society in a frozen world. Gather, expand, and forge your train while building powerful synergies with mighty artifacts. Your position—and the safety of your passengers—now rests in your hands.
games.about: Frostrain 2 is a roguelike game built around synergy-building, with a touch of management elements added to the mix. In this frozen world, you take on the role of the last remaining Conductor within the train society and must lead your passengers to survival. Acquire, place, and upgrade train cars to generate Happiness, and make decisive choices to determine the direction your train will take. Combine a wide range of train synergies with hundreds of powerful artifacts to generate more Happiness. Greater Happiness will further solidify your authority within the train society. Upgrade your train and arrange it to suit each situation. Proper placement and enhancement of train cars will allow you to generate even more Happiness. You are the last remaining Conductor of humanity, tasked with ruling the final train society. Each run presents you with randomly occurring events—respond to them, resolve them, and obtain the outcomes you need. Make decisive choices and lead your train society toward the future you believe in. As the Conductor, you must also decide the train’s direction. Travel through dozens of landmarks across diverse environments, find the optimal route, and guide your passengers to survival. At the end of each run, you will earn Purple Coins. Spend them to unlock new artifacts. As the story unfolds, you will uncover the tales of different Conductors. Unlock future Conductors and help fulfill their long-held aspirations. If you prove yourself a truly exceptional Conductor, you can guide your passengers even through the harshest conditions. Challenge the “Frost Mode” and discover hidden rewards. Fulfill certain special conditions... and you might just uncover the Conductors’ hidden stories.

games.name: Winter Survival
games.description: Winter Survival is a story-driven survival game where trauma turns reality into a reflection of your breaking mind. Battle cold, hunger, hallucinations, and adapt to the wilderness as it adapts to you.
games.about: Three different game modes – Story, Survival, and Cold Wave Story-driven survival experience crafted for new & veteran players who wish to rediscover the genre from a different perspective Sanity system that challenges your gameplay and turns the difficulty curve upside down Fully customizable experience – shape your own gameplay A dynamic environment that evolves as you progress, constantly increasing the challenge Winter Survival blends classic survival mechanics with psychological tension and narrative mystery. In Story Mode, uncover the story of Danny – a rookie survivalist whose only desire is to come back home. Learn basic and advanced mechanics of our survival approach and take responsibility for Danny’s future. Forge your own path in a sandbox-style Survival Mode, free of narrative constraints. Customize the gameplay the way you like, choose from different starting scenarios, and shape your own survival adventure. Or try Cold Wave Mode – a quick hop-in and hop-out survival experience where death is always a step behind. Survive as long as you can, gather as many gold bars as possible, and in the end, compare your score with other survivalists. Every run brings invaluable knowledge and better starting gear, potentially leading to a higher score. Sanity is your most fragile resource. As hunger bites, isolation deepens, and predators stalk the night, your grip on reality begins to slip as your trauma meter increases. Hallucinations, panic attacks, and even delusional predators become as dangerous as wolves or frostbite. And this is only a glimpse of the symptoms that you’ll have to carefully pick from. Craft tools, build shelter, and explore the vast, living world of Winter Survival. But remember — you are the outsider here. Adapt to the wild, expect the unexpected, and watch as nature reacts to your every move. With a vast open world at your disposal, explore frostbitten forests, humid marshes, abandoned settlements, and shadowed caves where silence screams. Move stealthily to avoid danger, use the terrain to outsmart predators, or face them in direct combat. Winter Survival introduces you to the basics and advanced mechanics of survival, but with our own twist. Looking for supplies or food? Scavenge the area that surrounds you or choose a more dangerous approach and try to steal it from wolves. Freezing to death? Lighting up the fire might be your true salvation. It will provide you with warmth and scare away wolves, but it might attract other predators – especially when cooking out in the wild. Want to hunt that deer which stalks the area? Great, but act quickly to secure that tasty meal before other far more dangerous creatures lay their claws on it.

games.about: Explore a vast interconnected world. Master fluid movement. Become one with Maseylia. Maseylia: Echoes of the Past is a true 3D Metroidvania built around freedom of movement, deep exploration, and atmospheric discovery. In a fully interconnected three-dimensional world, every new ability dramatically transforms how you traverse the environment — opening hidden paths, enabling sequence breaking, and rewarding curiosity at every turn. Key Features True 3D Non-Linear Exploration Explore a vast, vertically rich world filled with ancient ruins, forgotten cities, alien forests, and surreal techno-organic structures. Exceptional Movement Freedom Master fluid traversal abilities including Double jump, 360° air dash, Grapple and more. Ability-Driven Progression New powers don’t just unlock doors — they fundamentally reshape how you move and interact with the world, allowing you to revisit old areas in entirely new ways. Moebius-Inspired Sci-Fi Art Direction Discover a breathtaking universe where nature and ancient technology merge into surreal, living landscapes. Environmental Storytelling & Deep Lore Uncover the tragic history of Maseylia through exploration, ruins, and forgotten remnants. Movement-Based Combat & Epic Bosses Face hostile creatures and towering guardians in fluid, mobility-focused battles. Inspired by Metroid Prime, Pseudoregalia, and Hollow Knight but fully reimagined in true 3D. Will you uncover the secrets of the Heart of Maseylia?

games.name: Terra Machina
games.description: Dig deep, build big, and let science do the smashing! TerraMachina is a 2D mining and factory sandbox. Turn mountains of ore into powerful drills, weapons, and automated factories across diverse biomes. Play solo or in co-op for up to 4 players.
games.about: Dig to build your factory. Build your factory to dig even more. TerraMachina is a 2D mining and factory sandbox where every new discovery fuels bigger machines, stronger equipment, and your next expedition. Dig, dig, and dig some more! Put your drill to work on walls of rock and rich veins of ore! Mined resources go straight to a warehouse with unlimited capacity, so you'll never have to stop because your backpack is full. There are no enemies or traps to interrupt your mining. Dig as much as you like! Start small, then upgrade your gear until you can tear through layers that once slowed you down. Go faster. Dig deeper. Uncover strange ores, plants, hidden caves, and buried ruins. Send your discoveries to the factory and turn them into your next drill upgrade. Mass production. Massive consumption. Grow a humble crushing and smelting line into a sprawling factory packed with machines and pipes. Process ores with different compositions, shape metals into parts, and turn those parts into more machines. Advance through alloys, fluid processing, heavy industry, and fusion technology. Connect production lines, run machines in parallel, and put byproducts back to work. Then watch the factory you designed chew through mountains of material. Spend the output on stronger equipment and bigger factories. Make more. Use more. Keep growing! Build factories across worlds! Step through the gate into worlds with different resources and environments. Forests are rich in water, coal, and natural resources. Snowfields offer ice and snow for new production lines. Jungles supply acid, honey, and sludge. Unusual ingredients still have a place in your factory! Volcanic worlds challenge you with searing heat and resources such as lava and sulfur. Build local power systems and factories, process resources on site, and ship the results back to your home base. Wind, temperature, and humidity all matter. Decide what to produce in each world, and make its environment work for you. Overwhelm your enemies with science! Your factory can make much more than mining gear. Send enemies flying with a bat. Smash crowds with a hammer's shockwave. Unleash sword combos, lightning-fast KATANA strikes, piercing lasers, and swarms of homing missiles. Put all that industrial power to spectacular use! Take on nests in mining worlds or venture into ancient research facilities built around combat. Upgrade your weapons, equip a barrier, and face enemy hordes and towering mechanical bosses. Just keep an eye on your energy supply! Go solo, or build together. Play alone or in co-op for up to 4 players. Mine, manufacture, build, and battle as you please. Decorate a cozy corner of your factory, bring a cute pet along, and head out on your next adventure. Videos & Livestreams Videos and livestreams of TerraMachina are welcome! We'd love to see your mining adventures, factories, and builds.

games.name: Model Kit Shop Simulator
games.description: Build and run your own hobby shop in this first-person store management sim. Order stock, fill shelves, set prices, match kits with paints through the Hobby Basket System, and let customers bring their projects to life at Build Tables.
games.about: Model Kit Shop Simulator is a first-person store management game where every sale starts with a Model Kit. Build and grow your own hobby shop by ordering master boxes, unpacking deliveries, stocking shelves, setting prices, and serving collectors and enthusiasts. But running a successful model kit shop is not just about selling boxes. To maximize profits, you need to keep the right matching paints in stock, increase basket value through the Hobby Basket System, and give customers a place to bring their projects to life with the Build Table. Core Systems Hobby Basket System Customers do not just buy a single kit — they start a project. When a customer picks a model kit, they may also look for the matching paints needed to complete it. If you keep those paints on your shelves, they can add them to their basket, increasing the total value of each sale. If the paints are missing, they may still buy the kit, but your basket value and profit will be lower. Build Table System Customers who complete the right kit-and-paint combination can pay to use a Build Table after checkout. There, they sit down, start assembling their kit, and turn a box of parts into a finished model right inside your shop. This makes your store feel more alive and adds a distinctive hobby-shop experience beyond traditional retail management. Success depends on smart stock planning, efficient shelf management, the right product variety, and creating a store that supports both shopping and building. Features Run your own first-person model kit shop Order and unpack products from master boxes Stock shelves and organize your store layout Set prices and manage your profits Use the Hobby Basket System to increase basket value Keep matching paints in stock to support model kit sales Let customers use Build Tables to assemble their kits after checkout Unlock theme licenses and expand your product variety Grow from a small shop into a larger hobby business Build a store that hobby fans love and turn your small shop into a thriving model kit business.

games.name: Echoes of Elysium
games.description: Ever wanted to live on an airship? Now you have to. Echoes of Elysium is a co-op survival RPG where your airship is home, workshop, and war machine. Build a custom flying fortress, crew up with up to 6 players, and battle soul-powered clockwork beasts across a gorgeous, fractured sky.
games.about: Have you ever wanted to live on an airship? Now you have to. The serene skies of Elysium are both beautiful and deadly. Custom build floating fortresses, recruit your crew, and fight land and skyborne mechanisms in a paradise, filled with secrets, that wants you out. Play solo or with up to 6 players in online co-op. Uncover the mysteries of a forgotten paradise where soul-powered clockwork beasts lurk in every corner. Gather resources, craft tools and airships, and survive across fractured biomes filled with danger and discovery. Your airship isn’t just a base or transportation, it’s your home, your workshop, and your war machine. Customize every part, expand your fleet, and upgrade weapons to survive and explore the Elysian skies. From lumbering fortresses to nimble raiders, your design is the difference between glory and being scrap wood. The skies of Elysium aren’t empty. Face the Heron faction, swarms of flying mechanical monsters, hostile towers, and an armada of airships bent on your destruction. Level up, unlock new abilities, and craft gear and parts to grow from a fragile skiff into a floating fortress for you and your friends. At Loric Games, we are a small but passionate team of 12 creating immersive co-op RPG experiences that captivate audiences worldwide. Headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, we're committed to pushing the boundaries of innovation and storytelling in the gaming industry.

games.name: Castle Of Alchemists
games.description: Defend your castle in this fast-paced tower defense/action hybrid game with stunning pixel art graphics! Play as alchemically enhanced warrior Bellator, set traps, build towers, craft powerful weapons, and defend your home! The fate of the castle lies in your hands!
games.about: Forged by battle, Perfected by alchemy, First of his kind, Last line of our defence, Bellator di Alchemia. Castle of Alchemists is an action-RPG and tower defence hybrid where you take on the role of Bellator, an alchemically enhanced super soldier and fight against relentless hordes of enemies from other worlds. Craft items with randomised abilities that only a super soldier can wield, lay down deadly traps and build towers, mutate and advance to your perfection. Crush hordes of enemies as you reclaim the castle from the invaders piece by piece. If they come by the thousands, by the thousands they shall fall. Battle and defeat thousands of invaders from different factions with unique abilities, from a selection of more than 2 dozens of enemies. Craft an arsenal of weapons and items with randomised properties. Mutate and hone your skills through detailed skill trees. Number of traps and towers, each with a range of variants. Apply more than 10 conditions to enemies—slow them, stun them, burn them, freeze them, and more. Utilise synergies to quickly dispatch enemies: put metal traps struck by electric, set ablaze oils, or electrify acid puddles to spread explosive poisonous gases. Advance through levels set in diverse locations; the mines beneath the castle, the bustling forges of engineering, and silent lecture halls devoid of alchemists. Face bosses in special arenas, never-ending hordes in endless levels, or the challenges in increased difficulty mode for greater rewards. We are a two-person team working on this game with all our power. We are open to your feedback and want to develop this game with you to its best.

games.name: All Your Wrestling Pro Manager
games.description: AYW Pro Manager is the ultimate pro wrestling management sim. Take control. Book the venues. Book the shows. Manage talent and survive the boardroom. Ratings and fan trust matters. React to a living inbox and turn weekly chaos into a wrestling empire.
games.about: AYW Pro Manager Short Description AYW Pro Manager is a pro-wrestling management sim. You take control of a company and then everything is on your shoulders. You build a roster (hire, fire, suspend, deal with contracts), you create events in different locations and book shows, and most importantly - try not to get fired! About This Game AYW Pro Manager is a professional wrestling management game that puts YOU front and center. You are responsible for creating a world class roster. You can make transfer and loan offers for rival talent, you offer contracts (inc bonuses and merchandise cuts), you book shows and so much more. The game is packed with features and decisions for you to make. The Boardroom Once you have decided on a company to take charge of from the 30 available (and more to follow), you should check out the boardroom. Here, you can see the trust level of not only the board of directors, but also the fans and the TV companies. If the level of trust drops below a certain level then you receive a warning. 3 warnings and you are fired. You then have to take over another company, with a fresh batch of stars. Don't worry though, you have a helpful assistant who will give you tips along the way. Maya can be found on your dashboard and she will deliver messages to your inbox, as well as weekly and monthly reports. The boardroom shows a snapshot of your place in the wrestling world. Your position will be updated at the beginning of each month. Just remember - the board are watching and if you fail to improve your position, the board will likely mention this at your end of year performance review (yes, this does actually happen!!) Book Like A Promoter When you are familiar with your roster, you can book some shows! Create event takes you to a screen where you choose a name, a date, time, location (anything from gyms through to town halls and stadiums) and choose an image for your show (you can even upload your own). You need to create some storylines and ensure these are featured on your shows if you want to aim for those high ratings and ticket sales. Ticket sales will update as and when you book your shows and you can see these updating on the events screen. During shows, you are behind the curtain making decisions in real time. Before the event starts, you can add time to a match or you can delete a segment from the card altogether if you wish. When the event begins, you can check how each segment is performing with the commentary and reaction that takes place during the segment and also the crowd momentum will help guide any decisions. There is a wide variety of matches to choose from in AYWPM. In fact, there are over 100 different matches. You can also book exactly how a match will finish. Ref takes a bump? You got it. Chair shot after a run-in by a wrestler (of your choice)? You got it. Avalanche finisher into a submission? Why not? You can also book from a range of promos/angles, including a face off, a contract signing and many more. Another unique feature is the ability to add an advert to your show. This will gain money for your company (the longer the ad, the more money you receive) however, this will really annoy the fans. Manage The People Behind The Product Your roster will make or break your career. Handy filters will help you organise your stars and see where you may need to hire. When dealing with wrestlers, you will have to deal with contracts, morale, pushes, gimmicks, problems, problems and more problems. This is a wrestling promotion after all! Your top star is tired? Send them on holiday (this will cost you). Want to test a wrestler for drugs? Order a drug test. Need to suspend? You can do that too (and also decide if you will suspend with pay or without pay). This is just a small snippet of your roster. Build A Company, Not Just A Show The board is always watching. As you take charge of your company, you are in charge of everything, including; building a roster making transfer offers for rival talent contract offers and renewals booking shows creating storylines running the academy viewing and accepting sponsorships viewing and accepting TV deals and so much more! A Living Inbox This is where All Your Wrestling Pro Manager truly comes alive. Your inbox is the hub of the game. You will receive updates from your assistant Maya here, with handy tips and weekly and monthly reports. In AYW Pro Manager, you will also see a vast array of weird and wacky messages to keep your interest. You will need to react to your roster and follow up on any promises you make. Your inbox is your hub. Develop The Future Use the academy to bring through new prospects and shape the next generation of your roster. You decide which member of staff will have the huge task of being crowned 'Academy Head Coach' and take charge of your rising stars. You will receive a new batch of stars every January and you must decide to release or call up your academy stars. You can also decide on one star to put a lot of focus on, so choose wisely. Update - the academy is getting an upgrade. It was already fantastic but why stop there? In the upcoming update, you can run shows in the academy and check out how your academy stars are performing. Who is flying towards a contract? Who is buckling under the pressure? Finances Matter In AYW Pro Manager, you are in charge of the company's finances. Get a TV deal that covers different parts of the world, accept sponsorship deals (that have obligations you need to meet) and take a look at those merchandise figures (you can give wrestlers a cut of these if you are feeling generous). Merch sales are reported in the end of show report and you can see who is shifting units and how much you are making from them. Be careful who you accept sponsorship deals from though - your fans may not be too pleased and your fan rating can take a nosedive. Also, when you do accept sponsors you need to keep them happy and the sponsors will have certain demands that you have to meet. A fine will follow if you don't keep your end of the deal. Shape Your Own Wrestling World AYW Pro Manager includes a built-in editor for customizing wrestlers, companies, championships, shows, venues, teams, relationships, and game-world imagery. The editor is a strong piece of the game that will enable you to create your own universe and download it. You can then share it with the world as you also have the ability to upload other peoples game worlds. Easy to use, database uploads. Key Features Book house shows, weekly television, premium live events and more Run event day with live crowd reactions, commentary, and production changes Manage wrestler morale, injuries, fatigue, contracts, promises, and momentum Create storylines, teams, factions, rivalries, and championship histories Handle finances, sponsorships, TV deals, loans, merchandise, wages, and tickets Respond to inbox decisions that affect the company over time Work with board trust, warnings, requests, and long-term targets Develop academy prospects into future roster members Compete with rival promotions for market share Unlock 100 Hall of Fame badges across Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, and Legend tiers Customize the game world with the built-in editor The Future I have already made 8 updates to the game in its first 2 days, implementing fan requests. I plan to continue improving and expanding the game with updates, balance changes, quality-of-life improvements, and additional content based on player feedback. I am confident you will love the game, but I am also very keen to make improvements based on your feedback. You can catch even more updates and screenshots at the All Your Wrestling Discord page here: AI Content Disclosure Pre-generated AI was used during development to create fictional wrestler portrait artwork. These images are included as static game assets. AI was also used in the coding of the game.

games.about: The 1996 NEOGEO fighting game NINJA MASTER'S, beloved for its serious tone and innovative mechanics, is coming to Steam—now featuring online battles with rollback netcode! Preserving the original's graphics, controls, and arcade feel, this modern release adds several quality-of-life features, including smooth online matches, a fully equipped Practice Mode, and more. Switch between armed and unarmed combat in an instant for high-speed, tactical battles unlike anything else! ■ 12 unique characters, including bosses! A cast of 12 warriors gathers in the war-torn realm of Zipangu, a land trapped in 300 years of chaos. Join Sasuke, burdened by destiny, his friend (and rival) Kamui, the elegant kunoichi Kasumi, martial artist Natsume, and many more as they rise to challenge the tyrant Nobunaga. Face powerful foes, master unique styles, and carve your legend in this feudal fantasy! ■ Rollback netcode for smooth online battles worldwide! This version of the game has fully implemented rollback netcode, enabling stable, responsive online play. Jump into 9-player lobbies, queue up with Practice Mode standby, and toggle hidden characters with ease! Tournament mode lets you choose from single elimination, double elimination, and round robin! Face skilled opponents from all over the world and test your mastery! ■ Additional features to deepen your NINJA MASTER'S experience! For solo players, the new Practice Mode offers a range of training tools, including speed adjustment for combo practice—perfect for sharpening your skills before entering Time Attack Mode. Dive deeper into the game's world with a Gallery Mode featuring character artwork and rare design materials, as well as achievements with unique icons. This Steam release offers the most complete way to experience NINJA MASTER'S!

games.name: Ultros
games.description: ULTROS is a psychedelic metroidvania where you wake up stranded on The Sarcophagus — a cosmic uterus holding an ancient, demonic being. Trapped in the loop of a black hole, you will have to explore The Sarcophagus and meet its inhabitants to understand the part you play...
games.about: You wake up stranded, after seemingly crashing your ship on The Sarcophagus — a giant, space-drifting, cosmic uterus holding an ancient demonic being known as ULTROS. Trapped in the eternal loop of a black hole, you will have to explore The Sarcophagus and meet its inhabitants to understand the part you play. Are you the gruesome breaker of this cycle, or can you become a link from destruction to rebirth? ULTROS is set in a multifaceted realm - a vast alien landscape teeming with life. Grounded in science fiction, ULTROS comes wrapped in an eccentric art style and a mystical soundtrack from the visionary El Huervo, renowned for his work on Hotline Miami. ULTROS explores meta-themes of mental health, life, death, and karmic cycles through deep lore and environmental storytelling. Experience brutal, intimate, close-quarter combat with cosmic lifeforms, driven by a sense of urgency – where precision is paramount and every cut of your blade counts. Yet this intense combat is juxtaposed with cultivating the greenery and tending to plant life in The Sarcophagus, providing precious moments of contemplation and peace. In turn, this grants deeper access to obscured paths. The rich world of ULTROS holds many secrets for those curious enough — and fearless enough — to seek them out. A unique loop-based mechanic will allow you to start over at key moments in the story, providing opportunities to unfold such secrets, unlock different areas of the world and new abilities on a branching skill tree. Experiment with and master your own specific fighting style as you explore the world of ULTROS. Each loop brings you closer to the truth...

Play solo or enlist your own submariner crew. Up to 4 players can team up and survive an onslaught of deep-sea threats. Face down enemy submarines in naval warfare and dock your vessel to abandoned outposts in order to scavenge for supplies. A devastating disease has struck an alien planet. The government has frozen the surface of the ocean in response. You and your crew are trapped below the ice. Source fuel and travel from outpost to outpost in a desperate bid for survival Uncover snippets of information relating to a greater truth Plan and strategize every step of the way as you fight against the relentless adversity of a desperate world Resources are scarce. Discover and explore dilapidated underwater facilities on foot and strip them for all they’re worth. Be prepared to deal with what lurks below. Face down a variety of unpredictable enemies including infected divers, deep-sea angler fish and alien crabs. Even the odds using a wide range of weaponry including sledgehammers, blow torches, pistols and shotguns. Make sure you and your team have enough room to carry back the fuel canisters critical to your survival - teamwork is key to ensuring you live to see another day. Take direct control of onboard systems for piloting, weapons and sonar. Upgrade your submarine. Expand your deck, invest in different cabins, negotiate with rival vessels, but be ready for war. Utilize a variety of powerful torpedoes, harpoons, decoy mines and depth charges to gain the upper hand in sub-to-sub combat Board enemy vessels using a manned torpedo to deliver the ultimate in-person surprise Invest in unique rooms for your submarine that help with hacking, stealth and other strategic options

games.description: Delouse your room with sage and pack up your travel-sized ouija board, it’s time to re-enter Twin Lakes - America’s 34th most haunted city. games.about: Delouse your room with sage and pack up your travel-sized ouija board, it’s time to re-enter Twin Lakes - America’s 34th most haunted city. Join Detective McQueen as he puzzles his way through 9 chilling cases, risking life and pixelated limb to solve the macabre mysteries that plague the poor town. Twin Lakes is a cursed city. Less cursed than say, “Demons are tearing it apart” but more cursed than “always loses its keys” or “often steps in puddles”. It’s roughly in the middle of the cursed scale, is what we’re trying to say. Cursed enough that it’s a nuisance. Cursed enough that somebody has to deal with it… That’s where The Darkside Detective comes in. Whenever you hear a bump in the night, feel a tingle up your spine, or smell something fishy, Detective Francis McQueen isn’t far behind. No, he doesn’t smell of fish - it’s a phrase, come on... Picking up after the events of The Darkside Detective, McQueen has to save his usually-present (in body, if not mind) sidekick Officer Dooley from the Darkside, so the two can get back to what they do best - investigating the city’s many strange, often paranormal, always paradoxical goings-on. Join them in this frighteningly funny point-and-click adventure as they investigate nine more standalone cases bringing them to a carnival, the local retirement home, an amateur wrestling circuit and even as far away as Ireland as they do what they can to keep the Darkside at bay. Like how this sounds? Try the first title.

games.name: The NOexistenceN of Morphean Paradox : The Forest of Silver Shallots
games.description: You awaken in the Forest of Silver Shallots, setting out to uncover the secret of the Morphean Paradox. Above, factions weave their schemes; below, the black mist hides a swelling undercurrent. Time never stands still, and truth wears many faces. Not everyone can return to their fate…
games.about: This is the unfinished story between you and her—this is the journey that belongs to YOU… Awakening within the Forest of Silver Shallots, you set forth on a path to uncover the secrets of the “Morphean Paradox.” Across the land, the schemes of great factions ripple across the surface, while beneath, dark mist stirs in hidden currents. Forge bonds or sow hatred, and bear witness to the fate of you, your companions, and the Silver Shallot Forest itself. Guild Adventures Every adventurer needs trusted companions. You will take the role of a guild leader, guiding your allies and planning journeys into the Forest of Silver Shallots, where together you will write your own chapter of dreams. Schedule Management Adventurer, what shall we do today? Will you train alongside your companions, venture into the depths of the labyrinth, or accept a clandestine request from the black-market merchant? Decision-Driven Narrative Every choice you make may have the power to reshape the fate of this world. But tell me—do you truly have the strength to bear the weight of your decisions? Personalized Growth & Management Each character possesses six core attributes, along with a unique skill set and branching paths. You can influence every character’s progression and equipment, ultimately leading a squad of elite adventurers shaped by your own personal style. Strategy & Combat Bolins, goblins, assassin vines… the Forest of Silver Shallots is filled with peril. Choose your skills, build your party, and lead them into battle against dozens of different foes. A mysterious beauty from the Forest of Silver Shallots, Lilith is a swordswoman with a touch of magical skill. She claims her goal is to slay the Demon Lord and bask in the people’s applause—though her most pressing concern at the moment is snatching up discounted bread. “My name is Lilith, a Magic Swordswoman—good folks like you are rare in Golden Chalice Town.” Though she casually says “what a coincidence,” it almost feels as if she has been waiting for you in this vast forest all along… Yet phrased that way, it might sound a little self-absorbed—maybe it really was just a coincidence.Before blowing out the candles on her fifteenth birthday, Kallen was without doubt the happiest girl in the world—blessed with loving parents, a vast bedroom in her castle, and a kingdom full of loyal subjects. But on that fateful day, she made a single wish: to leave the castle. Following a butterfly into the forest, she returned only to find her kingdom shrouded in black mist, transformed into a living hell. There was no time to grieve—an inferno soon devoured everything she had once called home. From that day onward, Kallen’s smile vanished. In its place remained a sharpened scythe… and a heart consumed by vengeance. “Pray for your own safety—I won’t save you twice.” Turning away, she disappeared into the darkness—her only purpose now to hunt down the mysterious figure she glimpsed within the flames that day, even if it means severing her own emotions. For Fouco, life as the Demon Lord was nothing but endless drudgery—24 hours of routine: meetings on “advancing the modernization of the Demon Army under the New Era,” evaluations of destructive operations, and bureaucratic oversight of her underlings. She grew weary of it all. Abandoning her throne, she thought she could finally live a carefree life as a wanderer. Yet her successor, Rahabe, plunged the land into a reign of darkness—forcing Fouco into deep regret for her choice. Now, to atone for her mistakes and to end this unending war, she must fight as the former Demon Lord… against the Demon Lord herself. “I see… one step after another, a thousand miles in the making… Hero, you’ve truly thought this through.” Naturally, Fouco found her destined Hero—for she had already glimpsed countless futures where this Hero defeats Rahabe.Raised since childhood under the admiration of others as the so-called Bridge of Truth, Sartre’s life seemed destined to be smooth sailing. Yet such precocious brilliance soon drew suspicion and envy from her superiors—the old scholars at the institute dismissed her work as little more than castles in the air. Their endless jeers and criticisms weighed heavily on her, dragging down the pace of her research. Unwilling to waste her life in petty quarrels with mediocrity, Sartre severed her ties and abandoned her post at the Ninth Research Institute. What she needed was vast, uninterrupted time—time to calculate, to simulate, until she could complete the ultimate Genesis Grand Magic. “You’ve caught my attention. From now on, you’ll be my research subject!” …And yet, some new curiosity always seems to steal her gaze. The road to her great magic remains ever long. "Defeat the Demon Lord and become a hero" was Green's dream since childhood. At the age of 8, when he first witnessed General Satyr's brave figure at the imperial palace's military parade, Green quietly set the goal to join the Silver Griffin. As the youngest agent in the Griffin Intelligence and Countermeasure Department, Green Roland became a highly anticipated rising star. However, during a mission, an "accident" left him severely wounded, and when he regained consciousness, he received notice that he had been dismissed from the military. No one knows exactly what happened that day. Green Roland still roams the streets as usual, but today he has a new identity and a new goal. "I am Green, a hunter living in this forest." Since that day, Green has decided to walk down this thorny path. This Is Your Story with the Forest of Silver Shallots The Forest of Silver Shallots—a world that whispers with magic. Creatures reveal their bizarre and wondrous forms, while conspiracies weave their webs in the shadows. Here, you will encounter love, embark on journeys, and face choices left hanging in the balance. And of course, this is also OUR story— a tale that belongs to us alone… (*Please note that the game is currently in development and localized content is subject to change.)

games.name: Muv-Luv photonmelodies♮
games.description: Fall in Luv all over again! Familiar faces and worlds collide in three massive new adventures, including the long-awaited follow-up to Muv-Luv Alternative!
games.about: This compilation contains the following three Muv-Luv adventures:Adoration A novella-length spinoff title set in the world of “Duty ~Lost Arcadia~ The Euro Front” which offers a rare glimpse into what the world of Muv-Luv Alternative is like outside of Japan. When an uptight Japanese cadet gets stationed at a British military base during the final leg of his Royal Guard training, he thinks he’s got it all figured out. But he soon discovers that there’s more to being a surface pilot than sheer discipline when he’s assigned to the Cerberus Battalion, an esteemed TSF corps full of elite but eccentric surface pilots. Alongside a trio of buxom babes whose frisky flirtations throw him off at every turn, he’ll have to learn to loosen up and adapt to the unexpected in order to truly understand what it takes to be a soldier.Resurrection One month prior to the events of Muv-Luv Alternative, a cybernetic soldier named Silvio Orlandi arrives at Yokohama Base to work security detail at an upcoming Alternative Program summit — though in truth, he’s an undercover agent sent by the European Union for the express purpose of gathering classified intel about Alternative IV, as well as any other concerning projects the enigmatic Professor Kouzuki might have in the works. Upon arrival, however, he quickly discovers that this won’t be a simple recon mission, as the Professor’s personal detachment — the Valkyrie Squadron — seems perpetually poised to distract him at every turn. And yet, their playful attitudes and suggestive antics seem to indicate that they have no real intention of obstructing his mission… but could it truly all be just a coincidence? Or is there more to this situation than meets the eye?A Shimmering Shard of Spacetime The long-awaited follow-up to the original Muv-Luv saga is finally here! Picking up directly where Muv-Luv Alternative left off, Takeru returns to the wacky rom-com world of Muv-Luv Extra, only this time, things are more than a little bit different! When we last left Takeru, he’d just been introduced to his new classmates — the multimillionaire Meiya, her courtly sister Yuuhi, and the timid transfer student from overseas, Kasumi. Our story picks up with a class cook-off to determine who gets the privilege of sitting next to Takeru, but this is quickly overshadowed by a much more interesting reveal two days later. It seems Kasumi won’t be the only foreigner to grace the halls of Hakuryo Prep this year, as the school board has decided to participate in an all-new “teacher exchange program,” welcoming faculty members from all over the world in an effort to broaden students’ horizons. So you see, this isn’t just a simple rehash of Extra. No, this is an all-new adventure with all-new friends and possibilities. This is Final Extra. Join Takeru and the gang as they take part in all sorts of zany antics, from a school-wide airsoft tournament, to hitting the slopes at a mountain hot spring lodge, to getting caught up in an international conspiracy, to learning the true meaning of Christmas, to an all-expenses paid tropical island getaway — where Takeru might just have the chance to live out his wildest fantasies with the apple of his eye. Anything can happen in this new, rewritten reality — this Altered Fable — and it’s your story to unfold.

games.name: The Horror at Highrook
games.description: The Horror at Highrook is an occult card crafting narrative RPG. Explore a haunted mansion with your team of investigators, summon dark entities, craft powerful protections, uncover the fate of the missing family, and choose your own path through the darkness.
games.about: Explore an atmospheric setting on the edge of nightmare Guide a team of occult investigators to investigate the disappearance of a noble family. Keep your team well equipped and safe from hunger, injury, madness and disease. Each member of this motley crew offers their own unique skills to aid with your quest. But they also harbour their own secret ambitions... Master the dark arts Combine characters, items and locations to craft tools, potions and occult rites. Master a deep, nonlinear crafting system as you progress through the story. Explore eight chapters of cosmic horror. Each one presenting new challenges, events and characters.. all woven into this tragic twisted tale. Uncover secrets and defeat demons Track the lost family with your team. Complete challenges to access new areas, items and characters. Build an arsenal of relics and rites to summon and banish ancient horrors. Withstand earthquakes, abhorrent incursions and face your innermost fears. Delve into lore and mystery If your desire for hidden knowledge runs deep you can collect and peruse an extensive library of notes and letters. Revealing the dark history of Highrook, a gothic world inspired by HP Lovecraft, Edgar Allan Poe and Bram Stoker. Is it for me? The Horror at Highrook is an unusual game with some unique mechanics. There is a wealth of story, character and challenge hidden in the halls. There is a lot of text in the game and no voice acting (I couldn't afford it!) and that might put some people off, I understand. However, If you enjoy evocative writing, unpacking mysteries, and are wiling to experiment with a different type of game, then I think you will enjoy the journey! Check out the fully narrated gameplay trailer above to see how the game systems look in action.

games.name: Forsaken Remastered
games.description: Scavengers from all over the galaxy have come to a dead Earth to loot the remains of the technology that can found in underground tunnels. You must fight your way past the scum of the universe. As you prepare for deadly combat, you are going to quickly learn that the future is... Forsaken!
games.about: The team at Nightdive Studios, that brought back Turok and Turok 2: Seeds of Evil, are pleased to announce that on July 31st, Forsaken Remastered will be available for purchase on Steam! Developed by Probe Entertainment and Iguana Entertainment and first released in 1998 for PlayStation, PC and Nintendo 64, Forsaken was a vision of a dystopian future where science has gone out of control. Scavengers from all over the known worlds have come to Earth to loot the remains of the technology that can found in underground tunnels. But beware! You must fight your way past automated defenses and the scum of the universe to find the treasures hidden on each level. Forsaken is a 3D first-person shooter in which the player has complete 360-degree range of freedom. In a far-off future you play as a scavenger searching through the underground tunnels for weapons and treasures. But you face dangers from automated defense systems and other scavengers. As you mount your hoverbike, be prepared for deadly combat. You are going to quickly learn that the future is... Forsaken! The game features 5 devastating primary weapons and 9 unique secondary weapons with 32 challenging levels for maximum replayability and 6 multiplayer modes for up to 16 players: Free For All, Team Game (Deathmatch), Bounty Hunt, Team Bounty Hunt, Capture the Flag and Team Capture the Flag Forsaken Remastered has been lovingly restored by the developers at Nightdive Studios. The new added features include: Support for Widescreen and 4K monitors Super smooth interpolated movement for 144hz displays and beyond MSAA and SMAA anti aliasing Ambient Occlusion and Motion Blur effects Enhanced and improved particle effects OpenGL 3.2, DirectX 11 support New automap feature Unique levels and enemies featured in the N64 version Unlockable bonus levels not seen in the original release Localized text for English, French, German, Italian and Spanish Remastered display HUD Online multiplayer modes for up to 16 players Support for all the multiplayer modes from the PC version: Free For All, Team Deathmatch, Capture the Flag, One Flag CTF, Bounty Hunt and Team Bounty Hunt.

games.name: Knights and Merchants
games.description: KNIGHTS and MERCHANTS recreates the era of the Middle Ages. Apart from the purely fictitious geography of our world, all game elements and scenes are based on the Anglo-Saxon period, 1200 A.D. And we haven't used imaginary elements like fabled creatures, either. The player takes on the role of an ordinary captain in the Palace Guard.
games.about: KNIGHTS and MERCHANTS recreates the era of the Middle Ages. Apart from the purely fictitious geography of our world, all game elements and scenes are based on the Anglo-Saxon period, 1200 A.D. And we haven't used imaginary elements like fabled creatures, either. The player takes on the role of an ordinary captain in the Palace Guard. A conspiracy against the king catapults the captain into a situation where he finds himself responsible for the defence of the last royal province. This is all that remains of the shattered kingdom, which has been split into numerous small principalities and fiefdoms. And now even the king himself, ensconced in his capital, is threatened by enemy armies. This is the starting point of your Middle Ages adventure. Now you must win back all those provinces which once belonged to your king.THE SHATTERED KINGDOM: After many battles, a former kingdom has been divided into many small principalities and earldoms. The kingís troops were pushed back into one last royal province, and the rulers of the other provinces waged terrible, destructive wars against one another. The whole land fell into a state of chaos and now the former royal capital itself is under siege by the armies of the rebel lords. You belong to the last remaining group of loyal kingís men, and have been commanded to go to the king in view of the imminent attack.THE PEASANTS REBELLION: Build a prosperous settlement with a complete economy. Arm your troops and meet the enemy on the battle field! Master these tasks and the King’s subjects will be able to live in peace and freedom again.GAME FEATURES: Middle ages simulation and Real-time strategy 2 campaigns "The Shattered Kingdom" and "The Peasants Rebellion" with a total of 34 missions Skirmish Mode and 10 Multiplayer-Maps About 25 different types of buildings More than a dozen different types of characters Over 10 different troop types, including archers, scouts, knights, bowman and barbarians Multiplayer battles with up to 6 players in LAN or through the Internet New Musical Score

games.name: Ex Sanguis
games.description: Bleed the world back to life in a series of tactical, turn-based bloodbaths! Lead your STILLAE, elite warriors in the fight to save a dying world from the forces of STASIS. Slay foes, kick them back on the timeline, and trigger chain events where elegance and blood flow as one.
games.about: From the Sanguis of the Mater, the Stillae are born. Elite warriors who bare the last of their divinity's hope, you will lead them in a battle to save a dying world. Fight in tactical combat against the forces of Stasis and restore the flow of life! Your perfect plan Plan your next moves with dynamic turn-based combat, strategically triggering epic chains of events across the battlefield: Use Timeline Effects to speed up, delay or swap time position to impact turn order and outsmart your enemies. Play with your surroundings that can explode, ignite enemies, or block sight... changing the outcome of the battles. Leverage spatial effects like knock-backs, forced facings, flanking bonuses, and damage-over-time to dominate every encounter. Unlock a vast arsenal of abilities, each offering powerful synergies and deep build customization. Take on risks and progress Choose your own path and difficulty as you progress through the map. Take on high-risk, high-reward missions, head straight for boss encounters, or slow down to gather resources to increase your chance of success. All missions contribute to gradual progress and reflect the type of experience you decide. A Roguelite loop adapted to turn-based combat With each return, each playthrough, you carve new strength from failure and victory alike, unlocking forgotten powers and braving ever darker depths, where your greatest enemies await. The further away you venture toward the outer rim of the map, the harder the standard Missions become. Regain memories and customize your Stillae for the next round by changing their loadouts and names. A Crimson Rebellion In a world drained by the Purge, blood is defiance. Each drop of it paints the world in reds and blacks, as a reminder that life fights back. This is not just violence, it's a vivid rebellion in a pale, colorless world against those who would see it in Stasis forever.
