games.name: Space Beast Terror Fright
games.description: S.B.T.F. is a very hard arcade-style / rogue-like / perma-death first person shooter. You play as Marines who must brave dark, claustrophobic and terrifyingly intense Space Beast infested spacecraft in order to extract critical data and lucrative upgrades. Can you make it out alive?
games.about: S.B.T.F. is a very hard arcade-style / rogue-like / perma-death first person shooter. You play as Marines who must brave dark, claustrophobic and terrifyingly intense Space Beast infested spacecraft in order to extract critical data and lucrative upgrades. Can you make it out alive? The game revolves around the concept of a procedurally generated maze-like spacecraft which is unique each time, within which the Marines must search out DataCores to be downloaded. The spacecraft are infested with Beasts that are extremely lethal, and the Marines must brave these dark and hostile environments in order to complete the objective of retrieving all critical data and ultimately setting the Reactor core to overload. Aside from either all purpose automatic Rifles or powerful Shotguns, the Marines initially only have a rudimentary Tracker device that detects nearby motion as well as the distance to the nearest DataCore. The DataCores can however contain lucrative Upgrades that will empower the Marines with better ammunition, a better motion tracker, and other useful functionality that will significantly increase the chances of survival. Key to managing the unknown spaces within each spacecraft is the intelligent use of Doors, sealing of sections behind the team in order to keep from being overwhelmed from several directions at once. Closing Doors controls the space, but they also make it harder to flee if the need should arise. Additionally, automated Sentry robots are scattered throughout the spacecraft, and these can be activated in order to further aid in stemming the never ending tide of Space Beasts. Sentries offer a significant amount of additional firepower, and can often be the difference between life and death when the Marines are being overwhelmed. While Sentries are programmed to avoid firing when Marines stray are in their field of fire, friendly fire incidents can still happen. Once all DataCores have been retrieved, the final objective is to disable all Reactor Coolants in order to destroy the spacecraft. Once this is done the Marines only have 90 seconds to find their way back to the Airlock for extraction before the Reactor overloads, obliterating the spacecraft and everything aboard. Space Beast Terror Fright employs both procedural level generation as well as a procedurally arranged music scoring. Audio and visuals are all tightly synced to the action in order to deliver a super-intense combat experience that feels like an awesome action movie. Both local and networked co-op play are supported, with 1-4 players via keyboard / mouse and XBox 360 game controllers. Both local and networked play allow viewing all of the action via split-screen. If you want to try out a demo of the game you can download a .zip file here: Space Beast Terror Fright Demo. This demo is our original Greenlight submission and does not represent the current state of the game, but it should give you a basic sense of what the game is about. The .zip does not contain an installer, so you might have to manually install DirectX9.0c in order to run the game. See further instructions about where you can get DirectX9.0c at the bottom of this page: nornware.

games.name: Lamentum
games.description: Lamentum is a pixel art survival horror game, set in New England in the mid-nineteenth century.
games.about: Guide Victor Hartwell, a young aristocrat on a desperate journey to cure the deadly disease that afflicts his beloved wife, Alissa. Their last hope resides in the darkened halls of Grau Hill Mansion whose Earl has uncovered ancient secrets and forgotten sciences. He claims he can heal Alissa, but… at what price? Grau Hill mansion will open its doors and immerse you in a world of nightmares where you may be trapped forever. Lamentum is a pixel art survival-horror game set in New England in the mid-nineteenth century. To solve the dark secret at the heart of Grau Hill Mansion, you will have to immerse yourself in a nightmare world full of terrible creatures. Choose well in whom to trust, every decision you make may alter the course of the story. Will you survive? Lamentum is inspired by classic survival horror games like Resident Evil and Silent Hill along with cosmic horror masterpieces, especially the Cthulhu mythos. Lamentum is a dark and adult-themed game, in which the player can enjoy classic survival-horror gameplay. Lamentum is a classic survival horror, so our protagonist will attain different weapons and tools during his stay at Grau Hill Mansion. Victor will need a lamp to see in the dark, to use lock picks to open sealed doors and chests and use restoratives to recover his health. A myriad of other tools will be needed to forge a path through this twisting nightmare world. To defend against the dangers that haunt him, Victor will have many melee and ranged weapons at his disposal. Each weapon is different and has unique strengths and weaknesses. Choosing your weapon carefully is essential to survival. Firearms provide a huge advantage due to their range, but they consume ammunition, a resource that is scarce in Grau Hill Mansion. Many items may be hidden at first, use your ingenuity to find them. You can play Lamentum with keyboard and mouse (in the PC version) or use a gamepad. Your inventory is limited, and you will have to choose which objects to carry at each moment. In certain places you can use the item box to store objects for later use. Our inventory system allows you to create shortcuts to frequently used objects. This system allows players, for example, to quickly switch between a melee weapon, a ranged weapon and a potion, making combat more agile and effective. In addition, we can consult a diary that will record the thoughts and annotations of our protagonist. The world of Lamentum is full of nightmare creatures, each of them with different behaviors and attacks. Creatures are not the only danger in Grau Hill Mansion, there are traps that will reward your ingenuity or punish your mistakes with death, dangerous puzzles, and lethal environments. During your nightmarish journey you will meet other characters and strange beings. Think carefully about who you trust and who you don’t… every decision you make can have important consequences. Lamentum will have different endings depending on Victor’s decisions during the game. We want Lamentum to be a replayable experience and a challenge to obtain the best possible end.

games.name: Titanic Escape Simulator™
games.description: Investigate a dark mystery aboard the RMS Titanic before the final night becomes a fight for survival. Explore, solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and make impossible choices as history’s most famous ship sinks beneath the Atlantic.
games.about: Every Second Counts. History Is Inevitable. April 14, 1912. The final night of the RMS Titanic. You are a private investigator aboard the world’s most famous ocean liner. What begins as a routine voyage soon becomes something far darker: a suspicious death, hidden clues, locked rooms, restricted decks, and a mystery buried deep within the ship. Explore the Titanic before disaster strikes. Question passengers, search cabins, uncover secrets, and follow a trail that leads from the elegance of First Class to the shadowed lower decks below. But as the truth begins to surface, so does the danger. And then the iceberg hits. What was once an investigation becomes a desperate fight for survival as freezing water floods the ship, corridors tilt, lights fail, and panic spreads across the decks. Every choice matters. Every second counts. The ship will sink. What you discover — and who you save — is up to you. KEY FEATURES: Explore the Titanic Before and During the Disaster Walk through richly detailed areas of the ship, from luxurious public rooms to restricted service corridors, cargo spaces, machinery areas, and lifeboat decks. Investigate a Dark Mystery Search crime scenes, collect evidence, question passengers, and uncover hidden connections before the final night arrives. Puzzle and Lock Interaction Solve environmental puzzles, open locked doors, decode clues, and use tools to access restricted areas. Stealth and Tension Enter forbidden sections of the ship, avoid dangerous enemies, and uncover secrets others want buried. Dynamic Sinking Gameplay Experience rising water, tilting decks, blocked paths, failing lights, and changing environments as Titanic succumbs to the Atlantic. Survival Mechanics Manage cold, stamina, blocked routes, and physical hazards while trying to reach safety. Moral Choices and Multiple Endings In the final moments, decide what matters most: justice, love, or saving as many lives as possible. Historical Atmosphere Meet passengers and crew inspired by real Titanic history, and witness moments of human courage, fear, and sacrifice during the final hours. Do you have what it takes to survive the most famous shipwreck in history? Or will you become another soul claimed by the icy depths? The clock is ticking. The water is rising. Your decisions will determine your fate.

games.name: Treasure Beach
games.description: Scavenge the beach and run a cozy trinket shop by the sea! Find hidden treasures or trash, clean and repair your finds, put them up for sale, and upgrade your workshop. Dig deeper and faster to make more money and buy back the beach from the greedy hotel.
games.about: 🏝️ Scavenge, Shine, and Sell! Treasure Beach is a cozy trinket shop sim where you explore a sun-soaked coast, dig up forgotten items, clean and fix them, and sell them to quirky customers. Use your profits to upgrade your workshop, improve your shop, and slowly buy back the beach from the greedy hotel. 🔎 Search the Beach Every day, new items wash ashore. Grab valuables, toss trash, rescue sea creatures, and use your shovel to dig deeper for buried treasure. But hurry, tide comes back fast, and digging costs time! 🛠️ Tinker with Trinkets Dry, clean, polish, and repair your finds in the workshop. Each item can be improved to earn a higher star rating and sell for more. You can even turn them into wearable accessories! 🏪 Run Your Shop Put your trinkets on display, set prices, and serve customers. Upgrade your store and tools to grow your business and attract more visitors. 🎡 Visit the Beach Fair Play daily mini games for extra rewards, like shooting ducks or picking coconuts. More fun is always on the way! 📖 Complete Collections Every item belongs to a set, from pirate relics to sea shells. Fill your Collection Book and discover the stories behind each find. 🌊 Turn forgotten junk into seaside treasure Treasure Beach is all about chill vibes, satisfying loops, and the joy of giving old things new life.

games.about: June, 1983. The summer heat has arrived earlier than it does most years. By day there are cicadas, and by night, the higurashi. Hinamizawa, a small village in the Japanese countryside. While there are fewer than two thousand people there, every year, 'something' happens. For the past 4 years, someone has died, and someone else has gone missing. This series of deaths and disappearances is connected to the local resistance against a now-abandoned dam construction project. A murder during the construction, covered up by the local authorities, is being re-enacted year after year. Is it a conspiracy? A coincidence? Or perhaps a curse? Someone who was supposed to be there... isn't. Someone who wasn't supposed to be there... is. Someone who was alive last night is now dead, and someone who is here right now isn't alive. There is no way to avert this tragedy. There is no choice but to give up trying. But even so... please don't give up.

games.name: Orbital Madness
games.description: Orbital Madness is an incremental action roguelite where everything revolves around orbitals. Build an arsenal of spinning weapons, create ridiculous chaos, defeat hordes of enemies and grow stronger between every run.
games.about: ROTATING WEAPONS! In Orbital Madness, every weapon is an orbital. CREATE RIDICULOUS MADNESS! Build a different setup every run, become stupidly powerful, earn permanent upgrades, and unlock even more ways to cause orbital madness. DIE AND TRY AGAIN Gather as much coins and essence as you can during each run. Spend your coins in the skill tree and jump back in better prepared for the next run. REACH THE TOP The higher you climb and the longer you survive, the harder the game gets! Each level has a boss waiting at the top of the map. Make sure you are well prepared before taking it on! THE ORBITAL LAB Unlock and upgrade Orbitals in the Orbital Lab! Choose which Orbitals to start with and create powerful builds for each run.

games.name: Good Job : Night Hustle Simulator
games.description: Take charge of a business that no one could put on their resume. Manage the girls at the underground massage parlor, delight customers with herbal blends, expand your e-commerce business, and grow your empire without drawing too much attention!
games.about: ⚠️ This Isn't Your Typical Job Simulator! Then again, the job itself isn't exactly normal either! Good Job is packed with absurd humor, questionable decisions, and unexpected situations. If you're looking for a serious, realistic simulator, this probably isn't it. But if you enjoy dark humor and a little chaos, welcome aboard! No one ever told you, ”One day you'll run a massage parlor!" And no one ever does... Good Job is an unofficial night-job simulation. Sam is in jail. He left the keys with you. Now you’re in charge of a job you could never put on your resume. Start in a run-down room, manage your team, satisfy demanding customers, sell controversial products online, collect payments, and grow your underground empire without drawing attention.. What you'll do: Build a network of underground massage agencies 🙂. Produce and sell herbal supplements. Manage massage therapists, handle appointments, and oversee deliveries. As a side hustle, build an e-commerce empire for adults. Collect payments. By any means necessary.... Eat, sleep, survive… This city never stops! Get ready for one of the toughest simulations you’ll ever play. In this game, your customers have very specific needs! Build your team carefully, manage them well, and keep your customers happy! Build your herbal supplement business from the ground up. Produce your products, stock your shelves, and sell online to customers with very specific needs. Every pill matters. Every order is valuable. Every delivery is an opportunity. Completely legal, of course. 😇 A tough journey awaits you! There’s so much you need to catch up on! Survival is the most important rule! Eat, sleep, and be sure to earn money! Discover the perfect blend. The right formula keeps your customers happy, grows your business, and builds your reputation. The wrong choice, however, can throw everything off balance. Chemistry is hard. The rest of the business is even harder. Mix carefully.

games.name: Budget Cuts
games.description: Budget Cuts is a VR stealth game where you dexterously zip, sneak or rambo your way forward through thrilling, oil-splatter filled combat!
games.about: You are an employee at the mega conglomerate TransCorp, and it's your job to stamp papers and file files! Unfortunately for you, TransCorp is an expert in the business of manufacturing cost-cutting robots, and now you are about to be fired. Built for Virtual Reality from the ground up, Budget Cuts is a stealth game set in a dystopian office-scape with tons of evil robots and even more knives (for throwing and stabbing them with!) Use your TransLocator gun to teleport through the many departments of TransCorp. Sneak around corners, hide behind air vents, or go nuts with lots of robot-killing action! Budget Cuts Arcade (accessed through the arcade machine in the main menu room) is a free update that now comes with the base game automatically, and adds four new bonus levels to the game, new difficulty levels, as well as a new Arcade Game Mode with high scores for the best runs! Full patch notes are available on our steam newshub. That’s a very, very exciting thing.” Kotaku “I can’t wait to play more of Budget Cuts, which might be the best, most interesting VR game I’ve played.” IGN "Virtual Reality Sneak ‘Em Up Budget Cuts Looks Ace" RPS PLEASE NOTE! games.name: True Fear: Forsaken Souls Part 3
games.description: True Fear: Forsaken Souls Part 3 is the final chapter of the psychological thriller trilogy. With point-and-click mechanics, intricate puzzles, and cinematic cutscenes, immerse yourself in a dark horror experience that redefines the genre.
games.about: True Fear: Forsaken Souls Part 3 is the long-awaited conclusion to one of the most acclaimed psychological horror mystery trilogies. Building on the tension, atmosphere, and emotional storytelling of the first two games, Part 3 delivers the final chapter of Holly Stonehouse’s journey - a dark and unsettling investigation where every answer raises new questions until the truth can no longer be avoided. Crafted with a stronger narrative focus, deeper world-building, and more complex emotional stakes, Part 3 closes the story that has captivated millions of Players. As Holly follows the last threads of her family’s past, she finds herself drawn deeper into a mystery where memory, trauma, and reality cross. The final search brings the trilogy to its darkest, most revealing point - a place where the line between psychological and supernatural horror becomes razor thin. True Fear: Forsaken Souls Part 3 is a single point-and-click adventure in the tradition of the True Fear series, designed for players who enjoy atmospheric horror, investigation, and puzzle-driven storytelling. After uncovering the secrets of her childhood home and surviving the horrors of Dark Falls Asylum, Holly’s search leads her beyond the familiar locations of the past and into the final layers of the mystery surrounding her family. Letters, photographs, reports, and long-hidden evidence piece together a story that Holly has spent her entire life trying to understand - but this time the danger is more real, immediate, and personal. Players will explore a large variety of environments, reconstruct timelines, interpret conflicting pieces of information, and unlock intricate chains of puzzles designed to mirror Holly’s descent into the truth. True Fear’s signature balance of cinematic storytelling, psychological tension, and nonlinear clue-hunting returns with more depth and detail than ever before. Part 3 offers a significantly longer, richer, and more intricate adventure, designed to answer the questions that have been haunting players since the very beginning. KEY FEATURES: - 119 locations, 237 close-up scenes, and 29 in-engine cutscenes. - The chilling conclusion to the True Fear trilogy. - A dark, emotional story filled with twists, revelations, and long-buried secrets. - An incredible music score tailored to each scene. - 72 smart puzzles, deeper exploration, and an ever-present sense of dread. - Bonus content includes wallpapers, figurines, and much more, along with an incredibly engaging behind-the-scenes section that is sure to capture the interest of anyone who loves this trilogy.

games.name: Cat Quest
games.description: The multi award-winning Action RPG. Some say 'Diablo with Cats' others a 'Super-cute Skyrim', whatever your take, Cat Quest's loot-fuelled cat-venture is as beautifully crafted, as its combat and magic are ultra-satisfying. Universally adored by critics - it'll have you purring for joy!
games.about: Leap into a grand adventure in purrsuit of the evil Drakoth and your catnapped sister! Explore Felingard's huge overworld map, risk life and limb delving into dungeons for epic loot, and lend a paw to a furry cast of characters in a flurry of side quests. Combat in Cat Quest takes place entirely in real time, allowing you to get close to enemies with a slash of your blade, dodge roll to avoid a counter-attack, and then finish them off with powerful magic! Wield the ancient spells of Lightnyan, Flamepurr, and Healpaw to vanquish your foes! (Fur real!) Outfit your catventurer with a whole basket of equipment! Prefurr casting spells? Don an arcane hood, robes, and a staff to bolster your mana reserves! Want to protect yourself from attack? Deck out your catventurer with chainmail armor to increase your health and provide an extra level of protection. Weapons, armor, and spells can be mixed and matched to create the purrfect combinations for your playstyle! The world of Felingard is littered with interesting places and people! Discover a possessed town whose residents lust for obscene amounts of meat, assist the mages Mewlin and Meowgan in their search to break a magic seal, and locate someone's missing delivery of "House of Parchments" and "The Pouncing Dead". Exploration is one of the main scratching posts of Cat Quest, and with locations such as Bermewda's Triangle, the Furbidden Fields, and Pawt City to explore, it's time to get pawing! Experience an enchanting orchestral score inspired by classic RPGs!

games.name: Soccer Online: Ball 3D
games.description: Multiplayer soccer simulator. Control one player. Play online or with bots.
games.about: Features Multiplayer 11 Game modes 21 Stadiums Dedicated servers Antilag system Realistic physics Ball editor Customization Bots Tutorial Replays Statistics Soccer Game Soccer Online: Ball 3D is the first soccer game in a new genre. Control one player on the virtual field. Kick the ball high, low, hard, lightly, curve, lob, jump, dribble, sprint (dash) and perform tricks. Discover a multi-player football simulator played by over 1 million players. Gameplay Ball 3D is an immersive computer game where you have 100% control. The physics is powered by a professional physics engine, which ensures realistic ball behavior. Because this is a physics-driven game, you need to use the geometry of the in-game objects to control them. Third person camera view makes the gameplay very unique in the electronic gaming world. At last a game that lets you perform pixel perfect moves. Open yourself to an atmospheric, magic reality, gain access to a new world where your unreal fantasy of becoming a soccer player will come true. Not many aaa titles offer what you will find in this hidden gem, it may be your best choice. This competitive team-based game is a true marvel for real-life soccer fans, offering endless fun. Soccer Online Playing single-player vs bots is so fun, but this is a modern esport game. Play online in the cross-platform multiplayer and play with other humans over the internet (or local network). Exciting and addictive Co-Op/PvP is the strongest element of this indie game. More than soccer Ball 3D has other sports for you to enjoy on-line: Basketball, Handball, Ice Hockey, Racing, Battle Royale and more. In Battle Royale survival is the key. Carefully overwatch the entire battlefield and avoid your opponents at all cost. It is not a shooter, there is no crosshair, the only weapon you have is you). You win this combat only when all your rivals are "dead". Use your reflex to win this epic war. The racing mode is like a kart racer, but with discs. During the race you drive using your mouse and keyboard as a controller. In Hockey mode you play with a puck. Ball 3D is a multi-sport simulation game available on laptop/desktop PC (Windows), Mac/Macbook (MacOS) and Steam Deck (Linux). Absolutely unique soccer sim game for casual, hardcore and pro players, where your realtime reaction skills matter. It mixes arcade gameplay with strategy. Fast-paced, easy to play, hard to master e-sport game with creative mechanics. Great to play in 2025 and even in 2026. It may be a light, relaxing and cozy experience. Unlike many RPG games where you level up your character, here your quest is to improve yourself. Whether you prefer golf, tennis, pool, baseball, cricket, volleyball or any other olympic sport, you will still like Ball 3D. Teams Building your own team is half of the success. Choose a name/tag (FC The Best, AS Best Players, EAS-Vampires, Foot Monsters (FM), Greatest Among Many (GAM), FRE or any other) then invite your friends to join the party and become a real team coach/manager. Be ready to compete in global leagues, cups and tournaments. Wouldn't it be nice to join the elite and win the Ball 3D World Cup Grand Final? Reach the peak and become a God, a living legend, the undisputed best Ball 3D player on the planet earth (the GOAT). Meet new friends, write your story and fulfill your American dream! If you lose, challenge your opponents to a rematch. Invite 1, 2 or 5 friends, 6, 7, 10. Not enough? How about 25, 26 or even more. Cooperation is the secret formula. Your team is hollow without it. Try to play positional attacks or it may defend the goal like a tank, lock the penalty area, turn it into a fortress and try counter attacks. Parking a bus in the goal is a sensible tactic too. Picking the best tactic for your team is like solving a puzzle, use your head and logic. Stealing tactics from your opponents is not theft. It is your role to decide if you want to play with one striker or with two, with three defenders or with four. You may try accurate short passes to gain space or full power flat strikes. Try all possible ideas and alternatives or your team will fall. Welcome new players! Simple tutorial will teach you how to play. It will help you massively to improve during the humble beginnings of your career. It is like a sandbox that lets you practice your moves and tricks. Multiplayer The game offers very advanced and optimized network code, including client side prediction anti-lag system and great dedicated servers in various regions that offer low ping. It is one of the most dynamic highest-rated coop soccer games. If you like multiplayer or mmo games you will love it. Ball 3D is mainly not a singleplayer offline PvE game, but you may decide that it is too early to play with real people and prefer to try your 1st game solo vs bots (AI). Man of the match The name of the best player will be featured and shown on the board as the man (woman) of the match. Put your name there and become popular! It tastes really wonderful to reach the apex and become the hero of the match. Replays Replays (demos) will help you craft your soccer skills into an art. Watch the matches from various cameras, including: TV, Action, Top Down, Auto and several others or from the 3rd person perspective. Remember to record replays and save your "wow" goals for later. Soccer variations Try modes like: Darts, Ping Pong and others. Ball 3D is a super fun, rich and deep co-operative game not similar to any other. Different environments Play on the grass, darker grass, dried grass, sand (desert), snow, concrete or rust-colored gravel. Play during the sunny summer, cold snowy winter, rainy autumn or green spring. Do you prefer the daylight or the dark night? Clean hot sky, clouds, wind or maybe a rain? Play on stadiums like: Classic, Real, Small, Big, Good, Mega, Huge, a street city stadium called Urban and many others. Ball 3D is a colorful, peaceful, family friendly, non-violent (no violence, no blood) game about soccer with a bit of the old school retro vibe. It can be played by players of all age, kids and adults, boys and girls. No matter what your sex is. Whether you are 18, 24 or 50 years old, boomer or young. Other features The game also offers Steam Trading Cards and Achievements among many other features. Buy and sell in-game items for a very cheap price on the Steam Market (cheapest deals are for less than 0.99 dollars). Get free items (loot inside the boxes) for playing the game and then put them on sale or go to the market and look for some best-sellers for yourself. Visit the shop, where you can find paid items and some attractive discounted bundles that offer great value (halloween, christmas, valentine and others). Tweak the graphics and other settings to get far more fps. The game will work on all computers including bad low spec / low end hardware (potato pc). After you score a goal, you can turn yourself into a rocket, alien, spider, ufo, car, zombie, hat guy vs knights, and many other scary but cartoony monsters, plants and wild animals you may know from horror and sci-fi movies or cartoons. How cool and funny is that? Use stylized visual shot effects like: shadow, ghost, black trail, white shuriken, fire ball, dying star, red devil from hell, rainbow cubes, ancient artifact and countless others. Show emotions to by using special emotion items, the list is long: cute cat, pumpkin smile, wolf, crazy kiss, laugh, cry, XD, lol, bat. Use badges: dog, portal, loops, dwarf, dragon, underground, warrior, hand, heat map, spooky. Join our community. It's not difficult. Start playing soccer right away and begin a new adventure. Support Ball 3D was created by Unusualsoft. You can contact us by email, on the forum, social media or discord. Feel free to ask questions or make suggestions. We will be very happy to reply to you! Updates The game has been already updated over 250 times. Many fun things will be added in the upcoming releases.

games.name: Wavetale
games.description: Surf the waters of a submerged city! Unravel the past, save the islanders from mysterious sea monsters and discover secrets hidden under the surface.
games.about: Explore an open sea and the decaying archipelago of Strandville in Wavetale, a story-driven action-adventure game introducing you to fed-up fishermen, secretive hermits – and maybe a pirate or two. Traverse calm waters and surging waves as Sigrid, a young girl who befriends a mysterious shadow that provides her with the power to walk on water. Speed through the waves, swing yourself from housetops with your net, and defeat an old nemesis to save the citizens of the islands. On a certain day in June, someone dies, and someone else goes missing. The series of deaths is connected to the upheaval surrounding the dam construction project. A murder case that was covered up is being reenacted. Is it a conspiracy? A coincidence? Or perhaps a curse? Someone who was supposed to be there isn’t. Someone who wasn’t supposed to be there is. games.name: Obey the Voice™
games.description: You are here to listen to The Voice. Do what he says. But don't listen to other voices... Obey the Voice is a pressure-driven psychological horror experience built on constant threats and rule-based challenges, where survival depends on attention, timing, and decision-making under extreme stress.
games.about: After an accident, you're uploaded into a consciousness backup. The Voice guides you, trying to uncover who you truly are. But there’s a catch. You have dissociative identity disorder. Obey the Voice is a pressure-driven psychological horror experience built on constant threats and rule-based challenges, where survival depends on attention, timing, and decision-making under extreme stress. Rules You Must Always Follow: 1. If you hear a voice other than The Voice, ignore it. 2. If you encounter a being you're certain is not human, do not look at it. It may try to get your attention or simply ignore you. No matter what, do not look. 3. If you detect any sign of life having moved or moving, turn back immediately and press the red button. We will eliminate the threat and transfer you to a new section. 4. As soon as you complete the task you were given, turn back and press the blue button. Do not linger. Note: These rules apply to all sections unless stated otherwise by The Voice. Designed to be played in one sitting (~90 minutes), with relentless tension and escalating pressure. Features: In this game, you will carry out high-pressure tasks given to you by The Voice, paying attention both to the section rules and to the rules that must always be followed. High-fidelity, photorealistic environments. No randomized events. Every challenge is deliberate. Mistakes are punished immediately. There is no safe space. This is not an easy game. The Voice is designed to overwhelm you by demanding focus on multiple challenges at the same time. You often need to wait for the right moment to do the right thing. Getting trapped in tight corners, doing the right thing at the wrong time, and dying over and over again is exactly what The Voice wants you to go through.

games.name: Dispatch Control
games.description: Run a fire and ambulance dispatch center on real-world maps. Answer emergency calls, assess incidents and send the right crews while keeping units in reserve. Play Dispatch Control solo or in online co-op with up to six players, in free play or 16 campaign chapters. Available in English and German.
games.about: One emergency call. Limited information. Your decision. Take the dispatcher's seat in Dispatch Control, a simulation of fire and ambulance operations. Question callers, confirm locations, send suitable crews and follow incidents through to completion. As vehicles travel and updates arrive, another call may already be waiting. Set priorities and keep the bigger picture in view, even under pressure. Listen, ask, assess Handle emergency calls through selectable questions and responses. Establish the address and access route, identify hazards and calm distressed callers. Record new information in the incident file, handle callbacks and adjust your response as the situation develops. Real places, your response area Choose from 30 prepared cities across all 16 German federal states or search for another location. OpenStreetMap provides the foundation for roads, buildings, mapped stations and other locations. Track vehicles on the map and decide which nearby crew should take the next assignment. Detailed routing uses available road data and simulation rules to account for factors such as vehicle dimensions, one-way streets, bridge clearances and railway crossings. Simulated roadworks and accident scenes can force a detour. Weather, turnout times and units already committed elsewhere also affect your planning. Dispatch is only the beginning Coordinate fires, medical emergencies and technical assistance. Respond to requests for additional units, arrange patient transport and hospital handovers, and maintain coverage elsewhere in your region. A vehicle can move straight to another incident, but only if its crew and equipment are ready. Fuel, water, breathing apparatus, breaks and maintenance turn every dispatch into a resource decision. Major incidents require more than extra vehicles: coordinate triage, staging, hospital allocation and evacuation. If the phone system, radio network or dispatch computer fails, maintain operations through a backup control centre, emergency power and paper dispatch, then confirm recovery. Work solo or share the shift Play alone with simulated support or share a shift in online co-op through Steam with up to six players in total. Handle every task yourself or divide call-taking, dispatch and radio duties between your team. Calls and incident files have assigned owners and can be handed over, while the map, vehicles and incident status stay synchronized. Change the division of duties during the session. From your first call to a major incident A guided three-incident tutorial introduces the phone, dispatch and radio workflow. Progress through 16 campaign chapters from Bremerhaven to the harbour finale in Hamburg, with increasing call volume and new challenges. Select your next response area on the rotating globe and improve your performance to earn up to five stars per chapter – 80 stars in total. Or run your own shift in free play. In career mode, recruit staff, organize shifts and training, and invest in vehicles and operational improvements. Track your progress through 70 in-game achievements. Your control room, your workflow Arrange dockable phone, map, incident and vehicle panels to suit your workflow. Manage multiple radio groups, status reports and the incident log. Pause or change the simulation speed, and keep your shift with autosave and manual saves. The incident generator combines 24 scenario families with varying circumstances. An optional bundled local caller AI adds scenario variations and caller reactions. No cloud AI account is required. The simulation also works without a language model. Conversations use selectable options, not free-form voice input. Play in English or German English and German interfaces and on-screen caller dialogue are available. On first launch, the game selects a language based on your system settings. You can change it at any time in the settings. Optional English text-to-speech requires an installed English (United States) Windows voice. Simulation notes Dispatch Control is an entertainment game, not operational dispatch software or a certified training or medical product. Map data may be incomplete. Vehicles, staffing, hospital resources and procedures are simulated and do not represent a fully verified real-world control center. Travel times are estimates and road closures are simulated. Downloading map and road data and playing online co-op require an internet connection.

Multiple combat modes ensure that there's plenty of variety and fresh challenges ahead. Travel through hand-crafted levels that have been carefully designed to challenge you. New character progression system. Unique Party Alignment system. Combat Challenges, designed to test your tactical and party-building skills. Crafting, enchanting, legendary items. Upgradeable city.

games.name: FEED MY MECH
games.description: Your mech is all that stands between you and what writhes below. FEED MY MECH is a short horror experience—venture into a dead underground colony and recover lost tech. But something is spreading through the machines… and it’s looking for a way inside your mech.
games.about: Your mech is all that stands between you and what writhes below. FEED MY MECH is a short horror experience—venture into a dead underground colony and recover lost tech. But something is spreading through the machines… and it’s looking for a way inside your mech. GAME FEATURES An Immersive Kind of Horror: You are trapped inside of a mechanical chassis, you can't move, you can't hide, you can't run. Limited Vision: There are no windows to look beyond the cold metal walls of your mech. Make use of distorted, unreliable screens and maps to navigate the decaying environment. Exploration: Explore the remains on what could have been a prospering community and discover secrets that may hint to what went wrong. A Short Horror Experience: Can be completed in around two to three hours on the main path, but explore more if you wish, there are many secrets to find beyond that... PLOT The main portion of the gameplay is set within a mech provided by your employer, Solance Systems. They have tasked you with retrieving "Signals" from various remains of previous mech pilots in the area, any further information about your task is strictly confidential. Something goes wrong while you're down there, you are trapped in an old residential colony below your target location. While not intended, Solance tasks you with collecting the "Signals" on this lower, more hostile floor. They aren't carving an escape path for you until you do. Get the signals, get out, and maybe discover what actually happened to this residential colony on the way...

games.name: Interior Worlds
games.description: Snap your own homemade liminal space photos using a mysterious SLR camera as you explore a variety of empty, strange, and familiar spaces.
games.about: Empty lots. Blackened buildings. Dimly lit hallways. They all live and breathe just as we do. Welcome to Interior Worlds; an ambient and unsettling first-person exploration game where you'll dive into strange, yet familiar spaces. Temporary gaps and portals we cross at some point or another - now yearning for a closer look. A look that can only be seen properly through the lens of an SLR camera. Use your vintage and mysterious analog camera to capture stunning photographs of environmental anomalies throughout each space. Keep a sharp eye out while traversing the more... ominous locations. Track and share your own in-game catalog of photos, timestamped and pre-filtered with subtle layers of maximum liminal crust. Ten unique thresholds to traverse. A roadside hotel, empty movie theater, dying mall, and many more. Every environment is hand-crafted in a loving throwback to late 90's and early 00's graphics. A multitude of ways to capture photos. Adjust zoom levels, increase/decrease lens focus, tilt left/right for a dutch angle, and more. Create perturbing compositions in hundreds of ways. Unparalleled interactivity. Activate vending machines, phones, sinks, televisions, or simply turn the lights on or off for a different photo-moment vibe. Immersive and unsettling soundscape. Melt into an eerie mix of low, rumbling drones and soft, stretched pads during the journey. Thanks for checking out INTERIOR WORLDS. This game was developed by sodaraptor and normalhumansixx.

games.about: Welcome, Novice, to Holy Island, home to the greatest monastic library of the Dark Ages! You are tasked with running this revered place of learning, and completing our Legendary Collection... Every morning new books are delivered, each bearing a distinct symbol upon their cover. Remember them well! Then place them upon shelves according to thine own design. Cometh the night, you must deliver the Scribes their chosen tomes. Note that thou can reduce or disable thy foes if a more chilled experience is desired. Revel in a myriad of features and Quality of Life benefits with thy brethren: Explore a hand-crafted monastic library Carry books in great stacks or throw them vast distances Play first or third person Arachnophobia mode Up to four players Granular difficulty options: reduce, increase or disable some or all enemies Control book rates for a more chill experience Proximity voice chat Public and private lobby Steam invites Copy/paste lobby join codes In game text chat Full key rebinding Manual and autosave FoV slider Headbob slider Gamma slider Window or fullscreen mode Widescreen support Delight in the harmony of ordered shelves, the quiet rustle of parchment and the mirth of shared labour!

games.description: A cozy horror game where you own and manage a boba tea shop. Prepare boba teas, serve customers, and expand your menu to grow your business.
games.about: The Boba Teashop is a cozy horror game where you own and manage a boba tea shop. Prepare boba teas, serve customers, and expand your menu to attract more patrons. You play as Risa, a woman in her 30s who is tired of corporate life and has decided to chase her dream of opening a boba tea shop. As a boba tea shop owner, you will encounter a variety of customers. Your job is to greet them with a smile and take their orders. Making boba tea is simple. The ingredients are just milk tea and boba. Seal the cup with a lid and serve it with a straw for sipping and enjoying the boba pearls. But sometimes, you'll encounter demanding customers with special requests or those who leave a mess in your shop. As the proud owner of a boba tea shop, there's nothing you can't handle. While serving customers and managing your boba tea shop, you start seeing visions and hearing things. Is it all in your head, or is something haunting the place? This is psychological horror game that builds tension through eerie atmosphere, unsettling events, and moments of intense scare when you least expect them. Features: Gameplay: A simple yet engaging loop where you take orders from customers, prepare their drinks, and serve them with a smile. VHS Aesthetics: Experience the game through a creepy VHS filter that adds a nostalgic and eerie atmosphere. Story: Uncover Risa's journey and personal growth as she pursues her dream of becoming a successful boba tea shop owner. For content creators: You are free to create content from the game and monetize the gameplay by any means. There are no other restrictions from my side when playing the game

games.name: The Spectre Files: Deathstalker
games.description: Question. Investigate. Save the girl. SURVIVE! The choices are yours in this retro, wacky, b-class horror, FMV arcade game.
games.about: In 1984, Brian Colin, creator of Rampage, set out to make an FMV, laserdisc arcade game. The project was never released... until in 2017, when it was resurrected by Galloping Ghost Productions! Take on the role of Ed Spectre, a sharp witted detective on the case of Buffy McGuffin. She was last seen at the Derhatchett Institute. Its residents are some of the creepiest people you’d NEVER want to meet. Answer questions and search for clues as to Buffy’s whereabouts and try to find items that will aid you along the way. WRONG answers will get you knocked out and take you deeper into the Institute. CORRECT answers will creep you closer to the monsters behind the young lady’s disappearance. Get ready gumshoes for…. Spectre Files: The Deathstalker!FEATURING Unseen, recovered film from the 1980s Hundreds of different scenarios. A new game each play through!

games.name: Horn of the Warlord
games.description: Lead a Viking clan to glory in this accessible turn-based conquest strategy game. Expand your kingdom, raise armies, besiege castles and outsmart a challenging AI across handcrafted worlds built for endless replayability.
games.about: Horn of the Walord Become a Viking warlord and forge a kingdom through conquest, expansion and war. Lead armies across a fractured medieval world, seize territory, besiege castles and outmaneuver rival rulers in a turn-based strategy game where every decision matters and every victory is earned. Follow the journey of Jarl Eirik Stormborn and his sworn companion Torvald Ironhand as they leave Ravenmark behind and set sail in search of glory, wealth and new lands to conquer. Build a Kingdom through conquest Begin with a small realm and rapidly expand your influence across neighboring lands. Secure resources, grow your population and transform a modest stronghold into a kingdom capable of dominating the world. Every region strengthens your war effort, providing the resources needed to sustain armies, develop castles and fuel further expansion. • Conquer and control strategically valuable territories • Grow your population and economy • Secure food, wood, stone, iron and gold • Expand across diverse landscapes and terrain • Turn a minor kingdom into a dominant power Outsmart your enemies Victory belongs to the ruler who plans ahead. Success depends on choosing the right battles, building effective armies and striking at the perfect moment. Terrain, army composition, troop readiness and timing can determine the fate of entire kingdoms. Whether launching a lightning invasion or preparing for a prolonged war, every campaign demands careful planning. • Counter enemy armies with superior compositions • Exploit terrain advantages during campaigns • Manage army readiness and fatigue • Choose when to advance and when to regroup • Master the art of strategic warfare Besiege castles and break kingdoms Castles are the backbone of every realm. Upgrade fortifications to strengthen your defenses, unlock stronger units and secure your borders. When the time comes to attack, every siege becomes a strategic challenge requiring careful preparation and the right tools for the job. A poorly planned assault can cost an army. A well-executed siege can bring down an empire. • Build and upgrade powerful castles • Unlock stronger military units • Assault enemy strongholds using ladders, battering rams and trebuchets • Adapt siege tactics to every situation • Capture heavily fortified regions Face a fair but ruthless AI Every kingdom plays by the same rules. The AI receives no free armies, hidden resources or artificial advantages. It expands, recruits, attacks and defends using the same systems available to the player. If you lose, it is because your opponent outplayed you. • No cheating AI • No hidden bonuses • Strategic decision-making driven by risk and reward • Three difficulty levels for different experience levels • Challenging opponents that reward mastery Experience a Viking Saga Embark on a fully scripted campaign following Jarl Eirik Stormborn and Torvald Ironhand as they seek glory beyond the shores of Ravenmark. Fight through seven handcrafted missions featuring narrative events, strategic challenges and unique objectives as rival kingdoms stand in the way of your ambitions. • Story-driven Viking campaign • Seven handcrafted missions • Narrative events and character interactions • Unique objectives and challenges • Conquer foreign kingdoms and forge your legacy Test yourself in unique scenarios Beyond the campaign lies a collection of standalone challenges designed to push your strategic abilities to their limits. Defend kingdoms against Viking invasions, overcome difficult starting positions and solve carefully crafted strategic puzzles. Every scenario offers a different path to victory. Endless replayability No two wars unfold the same way. Choose from a large collection of handcrafted maps, or generate your own random maps, that you can edit to your liking.. Randomized starting positions, resource placement and rival kingdoms ensure every skirmish presents new opportunities and challenges. Fight for domination against up to five rival rulers and experiment with different strategies across dozens of battlefields. • Large collection of replayable maps • Randomly generated maps with map editor • Up to six competing kingdoms • Single-player skirmish mode • Local hotseat multiplayer • Hundreds of hours of strategic warfare The horn has sounded. Will your kingdom rise to greatness, or be remembered only as another fallen realm?

games.name: Guacamelee! Super Turbo Championship Edition
games.description: The definitive version of the smash-hit Metroidvania-style action-platformer, Guacamelee! STCE adds new levels, powers, challenges, and refinements to the sprawling, ridiculous, Mexican-inspired adventure of the original Guacamelee! Gold Edition.
games.about: Carlos Calaca has kidnapped El Presidente's Daughter, and he plans to sacrifice her in order to merge the World of the Living with the World of the Dead. Juan Aguacate, an agave farmer who stumbles upon a Legendary Luchador mask, must find the strength and courage to become the Hero he's always dreamed of being and put a stop to this. Guacamelee! Super Turbo Championship Edition is a Metroidvania-style action-platformer set in a magical world inspired by traditional Mexican culture and folklore. The game features melee combat, parallel dimensions and same-screen co-op. The original Guacamelee! received wide critical acclaim and was a finalist for both IndieCade and the Independent Games Festival's Excellence in Visual Art award. Key Features Non-Stop Fighting Action. An extensive move list, advanced combo engine, and anti-gravity grabs Multi-dimensional Platforming. Instantly swap between the Worlds of Living and Dead to traverse impossible terrain Combat moves double as movement, uniting platforming and fighting in a way never seen before Diverse, detailed world containing lively towns, dark forests, flowery canals and fiery volcanoes Drop in/out 4-Player local co-operative play, featuring independent dimension swapping Multiple boss characters (each with unique back stories), wide range of foes, and elite-class enemies Spectacular player abilities: The Rooster Uppercut, Frog Slam, and “Intenso” turbo-combat mode Create new custom costumes and share these with others via Steam Workshop Steam leaderboards, achievements and trading cards, support for multiple save slots, persistent cross-save-game costume unlocks Chickens. Lots and lots of chickens. Also Included: Guacamelee! Gold Edition The original Guacamelee! Gold Edition experience is also included with this purchase! Guacamelee! Gold Edition was the first version of the game released on Steam, before we added the new powers, levels, enemies, gameplay and enhancements that define Guacamelee! Super Turbo Championship Edition.

Psychological Nightmare The environment will change as you progress, becoming more corrupted as you unearth previous buried trauma. Solve these puzzles to unlock new areas and peel back the curtain of painful memories you forgot.

games.name: Nitro Nonsense
games.description: A chaotic party racer for 1, 2, 4, 8, or up to 16 players, locally or online! Race in split-screen or share a top-down view, build custom tracks, and fill them with traps and obstacles when you win. If you lose, don’t worry: you get to upgrade your car and come back stronger for the next round!
games.about: Nitro Nonsense is a chaotic racing party game built to be played your way. Race locally or online with up to 16 players. Grab a keyboard or your favorite controllers, play in traditional split-screen, or keep everyone together in a shared top-down view. Couch or online, one screen or several, choose the setup that works for your group and start racing. Win a race and the next one is yours to redraw. While everyone else is in the garage, the winner gets the editor. Raise and carve the terrain, reroute the track, resize the map, and drop in jumps, boosts, walls and traps wherever they will do the most damage. Build a clean competitive circuit, a trap-filled gauntlet, or something that barely qualifies as a racetrack. Falling behind does not mean you are out of the race. Every time you lose, your car improves. The more you lose, the more powerful you become, giving every player a chance to fight back and turning each rematch into an even more unpredictable battle. The Cannon spins out whoever it hits. The Hook latches onto the car ahead and slingshots you past them. The Jammer reverses their steering. The Brick Wall leaves a breakable wall behind you. Then there are mines, oil slicks, shockwaves, homing missiles, and the passives: shield, 4WD, hang glider, and a bumper that lets you ram without taking the hit yourself. Every environment is inspired by the landscapes, wildlife and culture of Chile. Race from the Atacama Desert to Chilean Antarctica, passing through Rapa Nui, the vineyards of the Colchagua Valley and the dense Valdivian forests. Along the way, you will encounter recognizable landmarks, native vegetation and animals such as condors and huemules all recreated in the game’s colorful low-poly style. Play it locally. Play it online. Build your own tracks. Lose, improve, and come back stronger. Play Nitro Nonsense however you want.

games.name: Kumitantei: Old-School Slaughter
games.description: Kill each other...for science! The class of '89 is trapped in an elite school killing game. Investigate, solve, and expose your classmates in Kumitantei™: Old-School Slaughter, an episodic murder-mystery ADV card-battler inspired by retro anime.
games.about: Is survival in the cards? Kumitantei™: Old-School Slaughter is an episodic murder-mystery ADV cardbattler that lovingly fuses retro anime analog horror with killing game! Kumitantei will consist of 6 episodes, beginning to release in early 2026. "The Empire of Japan, 1989... Awoken in a decaying old bunker, sixteen elite Absolute Students are trapped in a kill-or-be-killed Apathy Experiment. Will they band together to uncover secrets of this anemoic alternate past, or lose their humanity and lives in the present?" With a visual style inspired by Rumiko Takahashi’s Urusei Yatsura and '80s anime alongside classic Japanese mystery-adventure games like Danganronpa and Ace Attorney, Kumitantei™ thrusts you into a suspenseful character-driven killing game narrative where your deckbuilding and detective skills are the only keys to surviving. It's a creepy-cute love letter to decades of ADVs that wears its many inspirations on its sleeve: perfect for fans of visual novels, detective games, and deckbuilders with deep narratives. Features: Bond with your classmates! Get to know the Absolute Class of '89 by listening to them, giving them gifts, and receiving powerful cards to use during debates! Investigate grisly murders! Use your detective skills to comb through slain classmates’ crime scenes and take your evidence to trial! Survive the trial! Cut through the lies and prove your case. Inspired by Ace Attorney and the cult classic Danganronpa series, Clinical Trials can only end in bloodshed, whether it's the culprit's or everyone else's! Build your deck! Create absolute combos using cards you find in the Bunker and through bonding with your classmates to dominate the debates and trials! Please insert coin! Test your retro gaming skills in a variety of faithfully crafted anemoic riffs on true old-school arcade icons!

games.name: INCISION
games.description: Ultraviolent, fast-paced, merciless retro FPS action. Slaughter your way through nightmarish industrial mazes, transformed cityscapes, and surreal alien structures to cut down the Growth.
games.about: INCISION is a brutal, fast, merciless blast from the past inspired by the godfathers of the first person shooter genre like Doom, Quake, Blood, and Shadow Warrior. INCISION offers an experience that demands skill and focus from its player, and rewards them with intense carnage. Yours is a simple job. Cut, shoot, burn and decimate it all to stop the spread of the Growth. Mercy is weakness. Hesitation is death. INCISION is designed to be merciless in its difficulty, but the player will never feel weak in the face of danger. Your arsenal is varied, powerful, loud, and will easily turn enemies into sticky red puddles, as long as they don't first do it to you. Movement is fast and responsive. The story never gets in the way of the gameplay, but there is plenty of it to be found for those who seek to unravel its mysteries. Ten weapons of mass-slaughter, all including powerful alternative firing modes. Fire a volley of bouncing incendiary bombs from your shotgun. Lob grenades from your heavy machine gun to turn your foes into red mist. Do tricks with your trusty revolver to maximize its damage output. Spray a volley of four incendiary rockets and watch even the strongest foe crumble to ashes before you. Go berserk with a saw-spear that works as a long-range slashing weapon or a close-range buzzsaw. The world of INCISION has been transformed into a living nightmare where a ever-consuming, ever-growing mass of flesh and machine live in unholy symbiosis. All we hold familiar and comfortable has been turned into a network of hellish, rusty, pulsating labyrinthian series of factories that serve as the nerves and organs for some greater being that only seeks to merge, unite and grow. The Growth has seeks to unite and merge all life and technology alike, turning its people into machine-freaks, all of them designed to turn anyone who opposes its will inside-out. Augmented soldiers with burst-firing energy rifles, mad sycophants with ricocheting sawblades, machine spider-priests aka. "Spiderpopes" with homing missiles, and ancient things from beyond our world. INCISION's roster of monsters will keep you on your toes til the bloody end. What sets INCISION apart - and makes it so brutally satisfying - is its old-school extra lives system, with 1-ups scattered across the map to help you avoid death. You’d better hunt them down, because if you run out, the level restarts. No checkpoints. No quicksaves. Each level must be beaten in one go. INCISION challenges you to learn and adapt, sharpening your reflexes, your aim, your rage - until you’re no longer the prey, but the butcher of the nightmare spawn. Brutal. Unforgiving. But always fair. This is what a true FPS challenge tastes like. HEAD-BANGING & SKULL-RATTLING INCISION includes a soundtrack by Frédérick Chicoine "iNi"; An entire album's worth of atmospheric horror ambience and mayhem-inducing metal that will burst your veins with adrenaline. Dive in!

games.name: Occlude
games.description: Occlude is a ritual disguised as Solitaire; a cosmic-horror card game where the rules are obscured and reality is at stake. Play through cryptic challenges to reveal forbidden lore in this singleplayer narrative puzzle game for the terminally curious. Don’t worry; you can always start over.
games.about: You thought you knew the rules. You don't. Have you ever done something you regret? What if I told you there was a way to fix it? Make it so that something never happened at all; or perhaps, just happened differently. What if I told you it was as simple as a game of solitaire? What if I told you that the game’s name was Occlude? The game’s not simple. The rules are hidden, and you find them by playing and experimenting. Make sure you have some coins - the coins will show when you’re on the right path. There are seven Rituals, each their own puzzle, increasing in difficulty. There are seven Entities, and they know you’re playing. Don’t worry about them. Worrying doesn’t do anything. I shouldn’t have mentioned them at all. Occlude is an occult game of solitaire stuffed with secrets. Piece together the rules even as they resist your attempts to decipher them. Uncover the brain-melting story behind the game that was never a game as you chip away at reality one card at a time. Develop your mastery of each Ritual to gain access to even deeper, forbidden lore in the Archives. Solitaire: but not as you know it. Seven Rituals: progress through increasingly complex card puzzles with unique hidden rulesets. Twenty-four Cardinals: unlock Cardinals, variations of Rituals that stand as unique puzzles in their own right. Two modes: The fiendishly difficult Classic Mode and our new, pleasantly vexing Story Mode with less punishing RNG, a second free cell and unlimited Undo. Reality-bending narrative: uncover a cosmic horror story about a world broken by countless attempts to fix it. Atmospheric sound design: immersive audio cues that shift based on your closeness to solving each puzzle. Secret documents: discover fragments of forbidden texts that provide clues about Occlude's origins. Terrible secrets: for those foolish enough to look for them.

games.name: STASIS
games.description: STASIS The isometric, point-and-click, sci-fi horror adventure game! In the distant future aboard a seemingly abandoned spacecraft, John Maracheck awakes from stasis. He must push himself to new physical and emotional limits and unravel the mysteries around him.
games.about: VOTED BEST ADVENTURE GAME OF 2015! STASIS is a point-and-click, sci-fi - horror adventure game played from a unique isometric perspective. STASIS intertwines a gruesome narrative with retro adventure gameplay. Combine items, interact with computers and solve puzzles while experiencing the gritty atmosphere. In the distant future, aboard a seemingly abandoned spacecraft, John Maracheck awakes from stasis. He must push himself to new physical and emotional limits and unravel the mysteries around him. John is in tremendous pain, his wife and daughter are missing, and time is running out as the Groomlake plunges further into the swirling blue methane clouds of Neptune. KEY FEATURES Challenging and realistic puzzles Cinematic AAA music composed by Mark Morgan (Fallout) Highly detailed 2D isometric graphics Classic point-and-click interaction Multiple characters to engage and work with John can (and will) die in the most horrific ways imaginable Special objects can be used on John himself to end it all A holographic stripper STORY A compelling dystopian narrative intertwines this mature adventure tale. Access computer terminals and engage with the environment like never before. A great deal of character backstory and information can also be found on the PDAs littered around the corpses aboard the Groomlake. GAMEPLAY Click, read and interact to explore the dark corners of the Groomlake, to gather inventory items and clues to help solve puzzles to progress further. GRAPHICS STASIS has an isometric visual aesthetic that brings a new angle to adventure games. Each scene has been individually detailed and created to craft the perfect backdrop for the gloomy adventure. While uniquely isometric, be ready for riveting cut scenes. VOICE ACTING The story unfolds with professional voice acting and a rising score - emotive on both accounts. The talented voice artists build up the depth of each the characters that you'll meet. MUSIC The legendary Mark Morgan (Wasteland 2, Fallout) has created a moving score, steeped in fear and emotion. Additional music has been penned by Daniel Sadowski (Counter-Strike: Global Offensive, Warhammer) who has given the soundtrack a unique cinematic edge. STASIS has lovingly been crafted by Christopher Bischoff for the past 5 years. In 2013, a successful Kickstarter aided in the further development of the game. games.name: Spooky Express
games.description: All the passengers are dying to ride the Spooky Express! Don’t let them miss their stops: they may be monsters, but they still have places to be and people to eat – er, we mean meet!
games.about: Take charge of the Spooky Express; the only rail service willing to carry the undead passengers of deepest, darkest Trainsylvania. In your new role you'll plan routes and lay train tracks to meet your creepy commuters' demands, and create a rail network spanning more than 200 thoughtfully designed levels. Each monster has a home of their own: take the vampires to their coffins and the zombies to their graves, and escort the interloping humans away before they’re snacked upon. There’s only room for one at a time in the passenger car and the track can’t cross itself, so plot your route carefully, lay the tracks, and don't let the train miss its stops. Trainsylvania spans a host of unique locations, with each puzzle forming a cosy diorama, complete with spooky soundtrack. Whether you're puzzling through the Pumpkin Patch, meandering through the Morbid Manor, or investigating the Impish Inferno, you'll find playful touches and surprises around every corner. 🦇 An elegant, playful puzzler, jam-packed with monsters and mechanics. 🚂 Thoughtfully designed puzzles which expertly balance complexity and approachability. 🎃 Created by the award-winning designers of A Monster's Expedition, A Good Snowman Is Hard To Build, Cosmic Express and more. 🎨 Featuring several delightful comics from David Hellman and Zac Gorman. 🎵 Accompanied by a haunting soundtrack from Priscilla Snow. No generative artificial intelligence (AI) was used in the creation of this game or promotional materials. Draknek & Friends believes in the value of real human labour and inspiration in all of our endeavours.

games.about: HOW LONG CAN YOU SURVIVE THE STOLEN REALM? Stolen Realm Survivors is an online co-op survivors-like auto-shooter set in the world of Stolen Realm. Battle relentless hordes, collect powerful artifacts, modify unique skills, and unleash devastating combos as the chaos escalates. Play solo or with friends and push your build as far as it can go before the onslaught overwhelms you. REVERSE BULLET HELL, PURE BUILD CRAFTING Your character attacks automatically; survival is up to you. Dodge through swarming enemies, position carefully, and make smart upgrade choices as the screen fills with chaos. Combine skills, artifacts, and passives to create wildly different builds each run, from precise spellcasters to screen-clearing powerhouses. Every choice matters. Every run is different. GROW STRONGER WITH EVERY RUN Defeat enemies, complete quests, and take on dangerous events to earn powerful rewards. Level up, collect loot, and modify diverse skills to shape your playstyle on the fly. Push deeper into the Realm to face tougher enemies, deadlier encounters, and greater rewards. The longer you survive, the more absurdly powerful your build can become. DYNAMIC QUESTS & BRANCHING PATHS Encounter story driven events that twist your run in unexpected ways. Take on quests with objectives like survival challenges, kill counts, protection missions, and resource collection: each offering powerful, build defining rewards. Navigate a branching map where every choice reshapes your journey. Choose your path through escalating battles, quests, shops, shrines, treasure, and bosses. In co op, vote with your party to decide your fate and adapt your strategy as the Realm shifts around you. ONLINE CO-OP SURVIVAL Survive alone or team up with friends in online co-op. Coordinate movement, builds, and upgrades to withstand overwhelming odds as a team. Whether you’re playing carefully or embracing total chaos, survival is always better with allies at your side. THE STOLEN REALM, REIMAGINED Explore the Stolen Realm from a top-down perspective built for nonstop survivors-like action as you escape the ominous halls of Castle Gloom. Experience the Realm in a fast, chaotic, and replayable new way. The Realm is relentless. How long will you last? COMMUNITY WISDOM “I only planned to play one run. games.name: Planet Centauri
games.description: Dive into an epic adventure alone or with friends! Explore hidden dungeons, capture and tame fearsome monsters, build and defend your village. Craft powerful weapons, master magical spells, and transform an planet into the cradle of a new civilization!
games.about: Embark on your greatest adventure to Planet Centauri! Discover new biomes, explore hidden dungeons, capture and tame monsters, build and protect an NPC community, craft your own weapons, and create your own magic spells! Save and protect the native Chloridian species from the evil Night Walkers! Develop and raise the Planet Centauri to the heavens as the cradle of a new civilization! Catch them all! Capture and tame monsters! Your new companions will support you and will evolve to become stronger! Each captured creature keeps its unique features, will evolve as it gains experience fighting by your side, and will even be able to have children if you find him/her a partner! Transformations Captured monsters can be sealed and thus, allowing you to transform into almost any monster in the game. Some monsters have unique abilities that you can use to your advantage, like flying or digging through the ground. Breeding Captured monsters can be placed in tiny houses containing a pocket world that can be modified to the taste of its occupants. When the monsters are happy, they will gain experience and occasionally, if all conditions are met, lay an egg. Traits from the parents will be inherited, allowing you to breed the perfect monster. Suffixes, characteristics, and runes Use runes to enchant your equipment with various stats and effects! Level up your equipment by killing monsters or with magical crystals. Weapons and armors share 7 levels of rarity! Higher rarity always comes with stronger, and more unique effects and characteristics! Monsters also happen to have rarity levels, rarer monsters being much more powerful and dangerous than their common counterparts, with unique abilities and reinforced stats. Challenge the RNG by using currencies to get the perfect traits on your equipment. Skills A wide range of skills enables you to fight with great mobility. Some skills can be chained, making combos possible. Elemental swords have synergy with skills. You can unlock elemental skills for each type of element (fire, ice, stone, electric, shadow, light), offering a wide variety of combinations. Classes Equipping a full armor set unlock new skills and abilities, making each of them useful in it's own way. From the miner to the shadow hunter, discover all classes by crafting all armor pieces! Equipment can be leveled to be useful at any time of the game. No set will be left behind! Craft your own magic spells! From controlling the arc and pattern of your fireballs to simply enhancing your survival abilities, craft a plethora of magical effects to fit your desires. Each magical element have it's forces and weaknesses: Fire spells are destructive and can burn enemies or the environment Ice spells can freeze and pierce through multiple enemies Electric spells are very fast and can electrify Stone spells will project monsters or petrify them Light spells are good for healing Shadow spells can follow enemies and pass through them Multiple elements can be combined in the same spell and monsters may have weakness to some elements. Spells are combined through an event system in a live editor with a lot of options. They can also be shared to your friend through base64 text. It's as easy as copy and paste. Agriculture and Cooking Eat well to get stronger has never been a more truthful quote than in Planet Centauri. Eating various types of food will cause your character to grow stronger and develop his abilities. Alchemy Extract essences from any plant, flower, vegetable or monster part to combine them into power full potions. Each essences is related to specific effects and can be used to craft related potions: life, magic, energy, regeneration, vitality, resistance, power and haste. Build a village and assign roles and jobs to its inhabitants Save the native Chloridians, build and fortify their villages. Befriend them and grant them jobs as Cooks, Guards, wizards, researchers and much more! An industrial area begins Build windmills or enslave chickens to generate mechanical energy to power your machines and transmit it through cogs and belts. Recycle materials, craft unique resources and upgrade your high friction cogs from wood to steel. Build mechanical systems using: Generators (windmill blades, chicken wheels, hand-cranks) Various kind of cogs (one way, double cogs, switches) Belts to connect cogs, build gear trains to increase torque or speed Pipe conveyors to transport items Circular saws and tracks to place themto cut trees automatically Pressure plates and mechanized doors Various machines like milling or crusher machines, table saw, block maker... Create without limits with our unique circuit design system! Planet Centauri's magitech allows you to design various electronic systems, from humble automated house lighting to calculators or even CPUs! This is achieved through an unique 'pipe' system to transmit soul energy up to 9 bit information signal and a large number of components, including: Generators harvesting soul energy from the environment Crystalizers to condensate energy to generate even more energy Teleporters Battery systems to store energy Lights, pixels, displays, Sensors and different kind of inputs Logical operators (not, and, or...) Mathematical operators (full adder, modulo, div, comparators) ACD, DAC, encoders, decoders, mux... Memories (flipflop, latch, 8-bit registers, counters) ROMs, using blocks placed in the world as a memory storage Transistors Here is actually the classic Game of Life cellular automaton implemented in magitech. Progression In Planet Centauri you won't be bothered by mandatory tutorials, linear progression or any forced main quest. Explore anything in the order you want, as long as you are able to survive. Be guided by the completion tree or the tutorial pages to explore all possibilities offered to you. Special challenges and ruins The world is filled by ancient ruins. On most of them, special challenges await you. Dungeons Discover unexplored dungeons full of traps. Maybe something unique and incredible will be found there. Construction With over 500 different type of blocks and decorative items, let your imagination run wild to build detailed or imposing structures. Any block can be shaped into a multitude of different slopes, or colored using paint. When a block is shaped, It is possible to combine it with another one. By combining double blocks and paint, possibilities are endless. Creative mode In creative mode you have access to developer tools, commands, terraformation, infinite items... Planet Centauri has a complex event system allowing you to create traps, spawn enemies and create complex mini games without coding. Currently, more than 20 different type of events and triggers exists. Event are like functions and perform a specific action. Triggers can emit different type of signals, and be connected to any other Event/Trigger: Zone triggers: Coming / Leave / ViewEnter / ViewLeave / ComingZone / LeaveZone Combat triggers: Spawn / KillMonsters / PlayerGetDamages / Challenge / Open Misc triggers: Counter / Switch / Chrono / ChronoLocal / PreciseTimer / Dice / HourChanged Event dispatching triggers: Hub / HubFilter / Dispatch / TimedDispatch BlockPattern to detect shaped structures (useful to make puzzles) DropItemsSouls CreateBlocks / DestroyBlocks / CreateDecorations / DestroyDecorations / Indestructible SpawnRope / SpawnTree / SpawnBall / SpawnLava Unlock / GenerateItems / ObjectAttributes / TriggerAttribute / AddAttributes / DisableLight SetPortal / WorldLocation SpawnOverride to modify permanently (or not) the world spawn tables Modding Steam workshop is not supported, but the game can be extensively modified. Any item in the game can be edited through text based configuration files in the PlanetCentauri/assets/moddable folder. You can add blocks, decorations, or any visual element without knowing a programming language. For more complex systems, like monsters or entities, the Lua programming language is used (like in Factorio, Hades, Don't Starve, Roblox, and a lot of games). The current limitation is the lack of a mod manager. This leads to potential problems and collisions between entries, and you have to distribute your mods manually.

games.about: MAIN FEATURES 🔸 Full weapon customization — paint your guns however you like using spray cans. This is the first VR game to feature such a system. 🔸 A large number of diverse locations and monsters to discover and face. 🔸 Over 30 hours of gameplay, offering a deep and fully immersive VR experience. 🔸 Next-generation graphics created using advanced VR technologies. 🔸 A blend of action, horror, survival and RPG elements set against the grim backdrop of a post-apocalyptic world. 🔸 An unparalleled atmosphere of solitude in a place where time seems to have stopped forever. 🔸 Realistic handling of a variety of classic and modern weapons. 🔸 Dangerous anomalies, valuable artifacts, a grim atmosphere, and dangerous bandits.
